text: En lönesc á n valgügn scienziá dl'Université de Stanford lascé alsavëi ch'al gnará fora n stromënt diagnostich nü che é bun da ordiné les zelules aladô dla sort: dër n pice chip che pó gní stampé cun stampantes a tinta por le prisc de zirca 1 n zentejim de dolar l'un.
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Aladô di inrescidus prinzipai podess chësc favorisé les diagnoses bunorides de tumors, dla tubercolosa, dl HIV y dla malaria de paziënc che vir te Paisc cun davagns dër basc, olache les rates de chi che suravir a maraties coche le tumor al dansö é ma le mez tan altes co chëres de Paisc plü ric.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: Le Gripen JAS 39C é tomé jö söla pista incër les 9.30, ora dl post (02:30 UTC) y é jü ciará, insciö á l'aeroport messü gní stlüt por i jori comerziai.
text_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Le pilot é gnü identifiché coche comandant dl scuadrun Dilokrit Pattavee.
text_en: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: I media locai á lascé alsavëi che n auto di stödafüch á rosedé tratan l'aziun de salvamënt.
text_en: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Vidal, de 28 agn, ê passé dan da trëi sajuns dal Sevilla al Barça.
text_en: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Do ch'al é rové tla capitala catalana á Vidal soghé 49 partides por chë scuadra.
text_en: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: La protesta á metü man incër les 11:00 ora locala (UTC + 1) a Whitehall dan l'entrada vardada dala polizia de Downing Street, la residënza ofiziala dl Pröm minister.
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Defata do les 11:00 á i desmostranc bloché le trafich tla direziun nord a Whitehall.
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Dales 11:20 á la polizia invié i desmostranc da jí indô söi tretuars, dijon ch'al é debojëgn da fá jí a öna le dërt da protesté cun le trafich che gnô majer.
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Incër les 11:29 s'á la protesta sposté a Whitehall, passan por Trafalgar Square, do le Strand, passan spo por Aldwych y jon do la Kingsway cuntra Holborn, olache le Partí conservatif tignî so forum d'aisciöda tl hotel Grand Cannaught Rooms.
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: Le record de Nadal tl confrunt diret cuntra le canadesc é de 7-2.
text_en: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Dan da püch ál pordü cuntra Raonic pro le Brisbane Open.
text_en: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Nadal á arjunt l'88% di punc a rëi tla partida, davagnan 76 punc cun la pröma batüda.
text_en: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Do la partida á le re dl saurun cöce dit: "I sun propi contënt da ester indô zoruch tles finales di tornés plü importanc. Sëgn sunsi chiló por porvé da davagné chësc".
text_en: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: "Panama Papers" é n inom coletif che tol ite incër diesc miliuns de documënc dl stüde legal de Panama Mossack Fonseca che ti é gnüs sporc pro ala stampa d'aisciöda dl 2016.
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: I documënc á desmostré che catordesc banches á daidé cliënc ric da ascogne avëis de miliarg de dolars por ti sciampé ales cutes y a d'atres normatives.
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Aladô dl foliet da vigni de The Guardian controlâ la Deutsche Bank zirca n terzo dles 1200 sozietés fintes che gnô adorades por chësc fin.
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Al é gnü a s'al dé protestes sura döt le monn, deplü prozedimënc penai y i scefs di governs dl'Islanda y dl Pakistan á trami dé les demisciuns.
text_en: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Ma é nasciü a Hong Kong y á studié tla New York University y tla Harvard Law School y á tl passé albü na "Green Card" americana por residënc permanënc.
text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Tratan les lites á Hsieh dé da capí che Ma ess te n tëmp de crisa podü s'un sciampé fora dl Paisc.
text_en: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Hsieh á ince dit che l'ester fotogenich de Ma ê plü na chestiun de stil co de sostanza.
text_en: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Scemia ch'al gnô acusé insciö, á Ma davagné saurí sön na plataforma che sostëgn lians plü strënc cun la Cina continentala.
text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: La sogadú dl de é Alex Ovechkin di Washington Capitals.
text_en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: Al á fat 2 goi y 2 assisć tla partida davagnada dai Washingtons por 5-3 sön i Atlanta Thrashers.
text_en: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Le pröm assist dla sëra de Ovechkin é chël che á porté al gol dla devënta realisé dal debutant Nicklas Backstrom;
text_en: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: so secundo gol dla sëra é sté le 60ejim de chësta sajun y insciö él deventé le pröm sogadú che é sté bun da fá 60 o deplü goi te öna na sajun dal 1995-96 incá, canche Jaromir Jagr y Mario Lemieux â trami arjunt chësc travert important.
text_en: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: Batten s'á classifiché al 190ejim post tla lista di 400 americans plü ric dl 2008, cun n patrimone sciazé de 2,3 miliarg de dolars.
text_en: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: Al s'á laureé tl 1950 tl College of Arts & Sciences dl'université dla Virginia y é sté n donadú important de chësta istituziun.
text_en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: Ala porjun irachena de Abu Ghraib ti él gnü dé füch tratan na revolta.
text_en: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: La porjun é gnüda conesciüda do ch'al é gnü descurí abusc sön i prijoniers, canche i soldas americans á surantut le control.
text_en: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Piquet Jr. á albü n inzidënt tl Gran Pest de Singapur dl 2008, atira do n pitstop bunorí de Fernando Alonso, fajon gní fora le safety car.
text_en: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Canche i auti dan Alonso é jüs ite a fossené do le safety car, é ël sté bun da passé dant tl grup y da davagné.
text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Piquet Jr. é gnü lizenzié do le Gran Pest dl'Ungaria dl 2009.
text_en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Avisa dales 8:46 dadoman êl gnü n gran chît te döta la cité, che signâ le momënt avisa che le pröm fligher â atoché so obietif.
text_en: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Al é gnü metü sö dui refleturs dla löm che slominâ de nöt sö cuntra le cil.
text_en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Tl areal vëgnel te chësc momënt fat sö cin' crazacii nüs, cun n zënter di trasporc y n parch dla memoria itamez.
text_en: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: Le program de PBS á ciafé deplü co döes desënes de pesć Emmy y süa dorada é ma do a chëra de Sesame Street y de Mister Rogers' Neighbourhood.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Vigni trasmisciun dl program se conzentrëia sön n argomënt te n liber spezifich y trata spo chësc argomënt te deplü stories.
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Vigni trasmisciun dess ince dé consëis de libri che i mituns dess spo chirí canch'ai vá te süa biblioteca.
text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant, de WNED Buffalo (staziun televisiva de Reading Rainbow) á dit: "Reading Rainbow ti á insigné ai mituns ciodí ch'an dess lí,... l'amur por la letöra – [la trasmisciun] á invié i mituns da tó n liber tla man y da lí."
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: N valgügn, danter chisc ince John Grant, arata che sides la mancianza de finanziamënc co n mudamënt tla filosofia dla programaziun televisiva educativa ais daidé pro che la seria rovass a na fin.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Aladô di meteorologs messess la tempesta, che é zirca 645 milies (1040 km) a vest dles isoles de Capo Verde, se desfanté ia denanco rové a manacé raiuns dla tera frëma.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Fred se möi sëgn cun vënc che vá a 105 milies al'ora (165 km/h) y al vá cuntra nord-vest.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred é le ziclon tropical plü sterch che sides mai gnü registré a süd y a vest tl Atlantich da canch'al é les imajes satelitares y impormó le terzo orcan de de majeres dimenjiuns registré a ost di 35°O.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Ai 24 de setëmber dl 1759 â Arthur Guinness firmé n contrat d'afit de 9.000 agn por la biraria St. James' Gate a Dublin, tl'Irlanda.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: 250 agn plü tert é la Guinness deventada n'aziënda globala che faturëia vigni ann 10 miliarg d'euro (14,7 miliarg de dolars americans).
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, copilot dl team A1GP dla Zelanda Nöia, á incö fat storia da ester sté le plü asvelt da passé legalmënter sura le punt de 48 agn dl port de Auckland ia.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Reid é sté bun da rovëne l'auto dla A1GP dla Zelanda Nöia, Black Beauty, set iadi sura punt ia, a na velozité de passa 160 km/h.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: La polizia dla Zelanda Nöia s'á stenté da odëi, cun sües pistoles radar da mosoré la velozité, tan dassënn che Reid jô, deache la Black Beauty é tan bassa y le iade su ch'ara é stada bona da le cronometré é sté canche Reid á arferé jö a 160 km/h.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Ti ultims 3 mëisc é passa 80 arestá gnüs lasciá lëdi dal Zënter de detenziun zënza gní acusá formalmënter.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Tl mëis de aurí de chësc ann á le vicar Glynn emetü na ordinanza de restriziun temporana ti confrunc dla strotöra, scrion dant la liberaziun de chi che é gnüs tignis sö por deplü co 24 ores do so arest zënza avëi ciafé na udiënza da pert de n comissar iudiziar.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Le comissar stabilësc la cauziun, sce chësta é gnüda conzedüda, y formalisëia les plüres dades dant dal ofizial che á fat l'arest. Les plüres vëgn spo metüdes ite tl sistem informatich dl stat, olache le caje vëgn aministré.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: L'audiënza fissëia ince la data por fá avarëi le dërt dl acusé da avëi n prozes asvelt.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, tesorier australian y la porsona che plü dessigü surantolará le post dl pröm minister Giuvani Howard coche surastant dl partí liberal, ti á dé so sostëgn al'industria dl'energia nucleara tl'Australia.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Costello á dit che canche la produziun de energia nucleara deventará convegnënta dal punt d'odüda economich, messará l'Australia ciaré da arjunje süa adoranza.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: "Sce ara pitará condiziuns convegnëntes, messarán l'avëi. Chësc ó dí, ch'i ne un degöna obieziun de prinzip cuntra l’energia nucleara" á dit Costello.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Aladô dl'Ansa, "se cruziâ la polizia de n valgügn atacs de pröm livel, che, sciöche ara aratâ, ess podü provoché na dërta vera de sezesciun.
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: La polizia á dit che al ê sté Lo Piccolo a la davagné, deach'al ê sté la man dërta de Provenzano a Palermo y, tres süa gran esperiënza, êl sté bun da se davagné le respet dla generaziun vedla di capi, che ti jô do ala politica de Provenzano da ne dé nia tl edl y da fá gní plü sterscia süa rëi de podëi.
text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Le podëi de chisc capi é rové tl momënt che Provenzano á metü fin ala vera menada dai Riina cuntra le stat, che tl ann 1992 a gaujé la mort di ativisć cuntra la mafia Giovanni Falcone y Paolo Borsellino".
text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: Le CEO de Apple, Steve Jobs, á descurí l’aparat sön paladina tiran fora l’iPhone de gofa de sü jeans.
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Tratan so discurs de döes ores ál dit: "Incö invënta Apple le telefon danü, incö fajunse storia".
text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Le Brasil é le plü gran paisc catolich dl monn y la dlijia catolica se á dagnora metü cuntra la legalisaziun di matrimoni omosessuai tl paisc.
text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Le Congres nazional dl Brasil á baié dla legalisaziun por 10 agn alalungia y chisc matrimoni zivii é al momënt impormó legai tl Rio Grande do Sul.
text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: La proposta de lege originara é gnüda scrita dal ombolt de São Paulo da denant, Marta Suplicy. La dessëgn de lege, do che al é gnü mudé, é sëgn tles mans de Roberto Jefferson.
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: I manifestanc spera da abiné adöm n miliun y duicëntmile firmes tres na petiziun da presenté al Congres nazional de novëmber.
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Do che tröpes families â chirí aiüt legal por combate cuntra les desfratades, él gnü tigní ai 20 de merz na incuntada tl zënter East Bay Community Law Center por les vitimes dles fraldes imobiliares.
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Canche i afitadins â metü man da cunté sö ci che ti ê sozedü, á la maiú pert dles families interessades capí atira che Carolyn Wilson dla OHA ti â arobé süa cauziun y s'un ê sciampada dala cité.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: I afitadins de Lockwood Gardens arata che al podess ester d'atres 40 o deplü families che risćia la desfratada, dal momënt ch'ai é gnüs sura che la polizia dl'OHA é tl laur da inrescí ince sön d'atri imobii publics a Oakland che podess ester gnüs trac ite tles fraldes imobiliares.
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Le grup á anulé le conzert tl War Memorial Stadium de Maui, olach'al ess tut pert 9.000 porsones, se scusan cun i sostignidus.
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: La firma che manajëia le grup, la HK Management Inc., ne á pité degöna motivaziun tl mëteman, canche ai 20 de setëmber ái anunzié la desdita, ti don spo le de do la gauja a problems de logistica.
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: I avocac grecs conesciüs Sakis Kechagioglou y George Nikolakopoulos é gnüs sará ia tla porjun de Korydallus a Atene, deach'ai é gnüs condaná por maladoranza de podëi y coruziun.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: De conseguënza él gnü a s'al dé n gran scandal tla comunité iuridica greca tres le relevamënt de aziuns ilegales fates da vicars, avocac, notars y procuradus ti agn denant.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Dan da n valgönes edemes, do ch'al él gnü dé fora les informaziuns publicades dal jornalist Makis Triantafylopoulos te so program dla televijiun conesciü "Zoungla" sön Alpha TV, é le deputat y avocat Petros Mantouvalos gnü desmetü da süa inciaria, deache mëmbri de so grup de laur é gnüs acusá por maladoranza de podëi y coruziun.
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Fora de chësc vëgn le pröm vicar Evangelos Kalousis tigní te porjun, deach'al é gnü condané por coruziun y comportamënt imoral.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts s'á impaca refodé da dí canch'al arata che la vita mëtes man, na chestiun importanta canch'an conscidrëia l'etica dl abort, dijon ch'al ne foss nia etich da comenté i detais di caji che pó gní a s'al dé.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Porimpó ál ël confermé süa afermaziun da denant che Roe v. Wade é la "iurisprudënza consolidada dl Paisc", sotrissan l'importanza de sentënzes coerëntes dla Curt Suprema.
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: Al á ince confermé da crëie tl dërt che fej pert dla privacy da chëra che la dezijiun de Roe depenô.
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: I Maroochydore é rová dancá tla classifica cun sis punc de vantaje sön i Noosa che é secundi.
text_en: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: Les döes scuadres s'á incunté tla semifinala prinzipala, olache i Noosa á davagné cun 11 punc de vantaje.
text_en: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: I Maroochydore á spo batü i Caboolture tla finala preliminara.
text_en: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Le Hesperonychus elizabethae é na sort dla familia di Dromaeosauridae y é n jorman dl Velociraptor.
text_en: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: An mina che chësc vicel da rapina curí de plömes y dal sanch cialt jiss sön döes iames da grifes coche le Velociraptor.
text_en: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Süa secunda grifa, che ê la plü grana, ti á dé l'inom Hesperonychus, che ó dí "grifa ozidentala".
text_en: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: Aper la dlacia che rumpî ite, á ince les condiziuns estremes dl tëmp arferé i intervënc de pröm aiüt.
text_en: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: Pittman á dé da capí che les condiziuns ne miorará nia dan la proscima edema.
text_en: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: La cuantité y la grossëza dla crosta dla dlacia é, aladô de Pittman, la peso che i iagri de foches ais odü ti ultimi 15 agn.
text_en: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text_en: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: Aladô di organisadus dla protesta, él rové adalerch incër 100.000 porsones tles cités dla Germania, danter chëstes Berlin, Köln, Hamburg y Hannover.
text_en: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

text: La polizia de Berlin á sciazé la presënza de 6.500 manifestanc.
text_en: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text: Al é gnü organisé protestes ince a Paris, a Sofia tla Bulgaria, a Vilnius tla Lituania, a Valletta a Malta, a Tallinn tla Estonia, a Edinburgh y a Glasgow tla Scozia.
text_en: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: Incër 200 porsones á manifesté a Londra dan da i ofizi de n valgügn di maius titolars de dërc d'autur.
text_en: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: Le mëis passé á la sotscriziun dl’ACTA da pert dla Polonia gaujé protestes violëntes, sburlan le govern polach da tó la dezijiun da ne ratifiché nia l’acordanza por le momënt.
text_en: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: Sides la Letonia co la Slovachia á sburlé le prozes d’adejiun al’ACTA.
text_en: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: Les assoziaziuns Animal Liberation y Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) é indô tl laur da damané ch’al vëgnes surantut l’oblianza da istalé telecameres CCTV tles mazaries te döta l'Australia.
text_en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: Aladô dla detlaraziun dl ispetur a ce dla RSPCA New South Wales, David O’Shannessy, al ACB, le control y l'ispeziun dles mazaries messess ester operaziuns ordinares tl'Australia.
text_en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: "Les telecameres CCTV menass zënzater fora n messaje sterch ales porsones che laora cun i tiers, chël ó dí che so bëgnester á la maiú priorité".
text_en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: La cherta internazionala di tremoroc dl United States Geological Survey ne portâ dant l’edema da denant degügn tremoroc tl'Islanda.
text_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: Al n’é gnü registré degönes tremorades tla zona de Hekla tles ultimes 48 ores da pert dl Ofize meteorologich islandesc.
text_en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: Les gran tremorades che á porté pro al mudamënt de fasa ê gnüdes a s'al dé ai 10 de merz dlungia le punt plü alt dl crater dl vulcan, söla pert nord-ost.
text_en: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: Al é gnü reporté la presënza de niores scöres a pe dla munt, nia coliades cun ativités vulcaniches.
text_en: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: Les niores ne lasciâ nia pro da savëi avisa sce al ess davëi podü gní a s'al dé na eruziun.
text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: Le Luno trasportâ 120-160 metri cubich de ciarburant canch’al s'á rot y al é gnü sburlé söla costa da vënc stersc y svac d'ega.
text_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: I joleri á metü a saul i dodesc mëmbri dla echipaja y la sora porsona ferida â le nes rot.
text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: Le bastimënt 100 metri lunch ê söl iade da jí a dô la ciaria de coltöra sciöche dagnora y tl mëteman se cruziâ i funzionars che le bastimënt ess podü rosedé na ciaria.
text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: La proposta de emendamënt é bele gnüda aprovada dal Parlamënt tl 2011.
text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Te chësta sesciun legislativa él gnü fat na mudaziun canche la secunda frasa é gnüda straicada naota dala ciamena di rapresentanc y é spo gnüda aprovada te na forma analoga dal senat le lönesc.
text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Le malsuzes dla secunda frasa, che fej la proposta da proibí les uniuns ziviles danter porsones dl medem ses, podess forsc ti daurí la porta ales uniuns ziviles tl dagní.
text_en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Ala fin dla prozedöra gnará la HJR 3 ejaminada danü dala proscima legislatöra litada, tl 2015 o tl 2016, insciö da resté sot a control.
text_en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Dlungia la rejia tol ite la cariera de Vautier n scioper dla fan tl 1973, ch'al á fat por combate cuntra chëra ch’al aratâ na zensöra politica.
text_en: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: La lege franzeja ê gnüda mudada. So ativism vá zoruch a canche al â 15 agn, canch’al ê jü a fá pert dla Resistënza franzeja tratan la secunda vera mondiala.
text_en: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: Al á cunté de se instës tres n liber dl 1998.
text_en: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Ti agn 1960 él jü zoruch tl'Algeria, che â impormó arjunt l’independënza, por insigné rejia por le chino.
text_en: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: Le iudoist iapanesc Hitoshi Sato, che á davagné döes medaies d’or olimpiches, é gnü mancia cun 54 agn.
text_en: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: La mort é gnüda danterite por gauja de n crebesc dla fe.
text_en: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Al é mort a Osaka le mertesc.
text_en: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Campiun olimpich y campiun dl monn da n iade, ê Sasto tl momënt de süa mort ince presidënt dl comité de formaziun dla federaziun All Japan Judo.
text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Almanco 100 porsones á tut pert ala festa por zelebré le pröm aniversar de matrimone de n per maridé l’ann passé.
text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: I funzionars á dit che la zelebraziun formala dl aniversar é gnüda fissada por n atra data.
text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: Le per maridé se á dé adöm l’ann passé tl Texas y é al é gnü a Buffalo por festejé deboriada cun i amisc y i parënc.
text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Le om de 30 agn, nasciü a Buffalo, é sté öna dles cater vitimes dla stlopetada, mo la fomena é romagnüda sana intun.
text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno é n maester de inglesc conesciü mo controvers, che á insigné ti istituc Modern Education y King’s Glory y che arata da avëi albü 9.000 studënc söl punt mascim de süa cariera.
text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Te sües anotaziuns adorâl parores aratades groies da n valgügn geniturs y, da coche al pé, dijôl volgarités te classa.
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Modern Education l’á acusé da avëi metü de gran reclams söles corieres zënza autorisaziun y da avëi mintí dijon da ester le surastant di maestri de inglesc.
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Al é ince bele gnü incolpé de violaziun di dërc de autur, mo zënza gní pluré.
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: N vedl studënt á dit "ch’al adorâ le lingaz da vigni de te classa, ch'al dê consëis por i apuntamënc tles anotaziuns y che al ê coche n compagn por i studënc".
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Ofizialmënter é la Cina ciamó n stat comunist, porimpó ara ti ultims trënta agn svilupé n’economia de marcé.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Les prömes reformes economiches ê gnüdes inviades ia dal govern de Deng Xiaoping.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Da dailó inant é le volum dl'economia cineja chersciü de 90 iadi.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: L’ann passé, por le pröm iade, á la Cina esporté deplü auti co la Germania, superan i Stac Unis coche maiú marcé te chësc setur.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: Anter dui dejená podess le PIL dla Cina ester maiú co chël di Stac Unis.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: La tempesta tropicala Danielle, la cuarta tempesta dla sajun atlantica di orcans dl 2010 a chëra ch'al ti é gnü dé n inom, s’á formé tl Ozean atlantich oriental.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: La tempesta, localisada apresciapüch a 3.000 milies da Miami, tla Florida, é caraterisada da bofs de vënt da 40 mph (64 km/h).
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: I scienziá dl National Hurricane Center arata che Danielle gnará plü sterch y ch'al deventará n orcan anter le mercui.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Dal momënt che la tempesta é dalunc dala tera frëma, él ciamó ri da odëi danfora les conseguënzes poscibles ti Stac Unis o ti Caraibi.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Bobek, nasciü tla capitala croata Zagabria, é gnü conesciü sogan pro le Partizan Belgrado.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Al é jü pro ëi tl 1945 y al é romagnü cina le 1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Tratan süa esperiënza tla scuadra ál fat 403 goi te 468 presënzes.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Tla storia dl club n’á degügn mai abiné adöm deplü presënzes o fat deplü goi co Bobek.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Tl 1995 él gnü lité le miú sogadú dla storia dl Partizan.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: I festejamënc á metü man cun n'esibiziun speziala dla compagnia renomada Cirque du Soleil.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: An é spo jüs inant cun l’Orchestra Sinfonica statala de Istanbul, n grup de janizers y i ciantarins Fatih Erkoç y Müslüm Gürses.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Spo él jü sön paladina i Whirling Dervishes.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: La diva türca Sezen Aksu s’á presenté cun le tenor talian Alessandro Safina y le ciantarin grech Haris Alexiou.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Inultima á la musiga da bal türca Fire of Anatolia interpreté le toch "Troy".
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: N pilot motoziclist de 13 agn, Peter Lenz, é mort do n inzidënt söl percurs de gara Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Tratan süa roda da scialdé ite le motor, é Lenz tomé dal motor y é gnü abiné dal colegh pilot Xavier Zayat.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Belatira él gnü daidé dai doturs de gara y é gnü mené d'emergënza te n ospedal local olache plü tert él mort.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat ne se á nia fat me tl inzidënt.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Por ci che reverda la situaziun finanziara globala é Zapatero jü inant sostignin che "le sistem finanziar rapresentëia na pert dl’economia, na pert fondamentala.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: I un na crisa finanziara lungia un n ann, che á albü so punt mascim ti ultims dui mëisc, y i arati che sëgn i marciá finanziars mëtes indô man da se trá sö."
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: L’edema passada á Naked News anunzié da orëi mioré dassënn sües ativités de reportage te lingac da foradecá, cun trëi trasmisciuns nöies.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: L’organisaziun globala, che trasmët bele por inglesc y iapanesc, é tl laur da mëte a jí programs por spagnol, talian y corean por les trasmisciuns televisives, le web y i aparac mobii.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: "Por fortüna ne me él sozedü nia, mo i á odü scenes da temëi de porsones che porvâ da rumpí i vidri por jí fora.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: La jënt sciurâ scagns cuntra i vidri, mo i spidli ne se fruziâ nia.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: Öna dles scëibes de vider s’á ala fin rot y spo ái metü man da jí da finestra fora," á cunté le suravit Franciszek Kowal.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Les stëres fej löm y cialt tres l’energia menada fora canche i atoms de idrogen se mët (o se delega) adöm por formé elemënc plü pesoc.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: I scienziá é tl laur da cherié n reatur che pois prodüje energia tla medema manira.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Ara se trata impó de na chestiun dër complicada da stlarí y al messará passé tröc agn denanco rové ala realisaziun de reaturs a fujiun efiziënc.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: L’aodla d’aciá se lascia mené dal'ega por gauja dla tenjiun dla spersa.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: La tenjiun dla spersa vëgn a s'al dé deache i molecüi d’ega söla spersa dl’ega se tira adalerch un cun l’ater plü dassënn co ci che ai ne vëgn nia trac adalerch dai molecüi d'aria sura ëi.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: I molecüi dla spersa cheriëia na folia nia da odëi söl’ega che ti pormët ai ogec, sciöche l'aodla, da sté sura ega ia.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: La lama di jadins da dlacia moderns á dui urs cun n büsc concaf amesaite. Le ur dopl garantësc na miú brancia söla dlacia, ince canch'ai é de travers.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Dal momënt che le funz dla lama é n pü' stort, canche la lama se oj da öna na pert o da l’atra, ince le fi che azica la dlacia se storj.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Y chësc ti pormët al jadinadú da oje. Sce i jadins se inclinëia cuntra man dërta, oj le jadinadú a man dërta, sce i jadins se inclinëia cuntra man ciampa, oj le jadinadú a man ciampa.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Por jí zoruch al livel de energia da denant, mëssi tó y jí l'energia ciafada dala löm che é surafora.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Chësc feji menan fora na particola de löm dër picera, tlamada "foton".
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Chësc prozes vëgn definí dai scienziá "emisciun stimolada de radiaziun", deache i atoms vëgn stimolá dai rais de löm stersc che gauja l'emisciun de n foton de löm y la löm é na sort de radiaziun.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: L'imaja che vëgn mostra sciöche i atoms mëna fora fotons. Sambëgn é i fotons cotan plü pici tla realté co tl'imaja.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: I fotons é ciamó plü pici co la materia che mët adöm i atoms!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Do cënc de ores de funzionamënt se brüj fora ingalin i fis dl për dla löm y le pirn ne funzionëia nia plü.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Le pirn mëss spo gní baraté fora. Al vá debojëgn da mëte averda canch'an müda le pirn.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Imprömadedöt él da druché la tlavela da destodé la löm o da destaché le cabl.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Chësc deache l’eletrizité che vá tl atach olach'al é la pert metalica dl pirn pó gaujé na scassada sterscia sc'an azica le daite dl atach o la basa metalica dl pirn tratan ch'al é ciamó en pert taché ite tl atach.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Le organ prinzipal dl sistem dla zircolaziun é le cör, che pumpa le sanch.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Le sanch vá dal cör demez te ros tlamá arteries y röia indô zoruch tl cör tres ros a chi che an ti dij avënes. Ai ros plü pici ti dijon capilares.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: I dënz dl triceratop foss stá bogn da spidicé sö nia ma les fëies, mo ince les rames y les raisc dër döres.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: N valgügn scienziá arata che i triceratops se nudrî de füresc de palma, na sort de planta che ê porleplü conesciüda tl eté geologica dla crëda.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Chëstes plantes ciara fora sciöche na picia palma cun na corona de fëies spizes y groies.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: N triceratop ess podü adoré so bech sterch por trá fora les fëies denanco mangé la taia.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: D'atri scienziá arata che chëstes plantes é dër da tosser y porchël ne él nia sigü che n dinosaur les mangiâ, ince sce le fraidiun y d’atri tiers sciöche le papagal (che vëgn dai dinosaurs) pó mangé fëies o früc da tosser.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Ci faziun ess pa sön me la forza de gravité de Io? Sce te fosses söla suraspersa de Io, pesasseste demanco co söla tera.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Na porsona che pësa 200 leres (90 kg) söla tera pesass incër 36 leres (16 kg) sön Io. Chësc ó dí che la faziun dla forza de gravité é sambëgn manco sterscia sön os.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Sorëdl n'á nia na crosta coche la tera olach'an pó sté lassura. Döt le Sorëdl é fat de gasc, füch y plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Le gas vëgn plü fin man man ch'an vá plü dalunc dal zënter dl Sorëdl.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: La pert deforaia ch'i odun canch'i ti ciarun al sorëdl á inom fotosfera, che ó dí "cogora de füch".
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Incër trëimile agn plü tert, tl 1610, â l'astronom talian Galileo Galilei osservé cun n telescop che Venus á fases, avisa coche la löna les á.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Les fases vëgn a s'al dé ajache ma la pert de Venus (o dla löna) ota cuntra Sorëdl é ilominada. Les fases de Venus sostëgn la teoria de Copernich che i planëc roda incër Sorëdl ia.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Spo, püc agn dedô, tl 1639, â n astronom inglesc, che â inom Jeremiah Horrocks, osservé n transit de Venus.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: L'Inghiltera â albü n tëmp lunch de pesc do la reconcuista dl Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Te vigni caje, tl 991 ê Ethelred dan na flota vichinga che ê majera co vigni atra do chëra de Guthrum n secul denant.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Chësta flota gnô menada da Olaf Trygvasson, n norvegesc cun ambiziuns da concuisté zoruch so Paisc dala dominaziun daneja.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Do i suzesc militars al scomenciamënt, ê Ethelred sté bun da se mëte a öna cun Olaf, che ê jü indô tla Norvegia por porvé da davagné so rëgn cun püch o tröp suzes.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Le Hangeul é le su alfabet inventé aposta che vëgn adoré da porsones tla vita da vignidé. L'alfabet ê gnü inventé tl 1444 tratan le rëgn dl re Sejong (1418 – 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Le re Sejong ê le cuarto re dla dinastia Joseon y al é un di plü sciazá.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Tl pröm ti âl metü inom Hunmin Jeongeum al alfabet Hangeul, che ó dí "i dër sonns por l'istruziun dla jënt".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Al é tröpes teories sön coche le sanscrit é nasciü. Öna de chëstes é chëra de na migraziun ariana dal ozidënt tl'India, che s'á tut para so lingaz.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Le sanscrit é n lingaz antich y pó gní confronté cun le latin baié tl'Europa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Le pröm liber dl monn ch'an conësc ê gnü scrit por sanscrit. Do ch'al ê gnü scrit adöm les Upanishads, ê le sanscrit jü zoruch por rajuns de gerarchia.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Le sanscrit é n lingaz dër comples y rich, che é gnü tut coche fontana por tröc d'atri lingac indians moderns, avisa coche le latin é la fontana por lingac europeics coche le franzesc y le spagnol.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Cun la fin dla batalia por la Francia, â la Germania metü man da s'arjigné ca por l'invajiun dl'isola dla Bretagna.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Al'ataca ti â la Germania metü l'inom en codesc "Operaziun Sealion". La maiú pert dles ermes pesoces y di refornimënc dl esert britanich ê jüda a perde tratan l'evacuaziun da Dunkerque, porchël ê l'esert plütosc debl.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Mo la Royal Navy ê tres ciamó cotan plü sterscia co la marina militara todëscia ("Kriegsmarine") y ess podü desdrüje vigni flota d'invajiun che foss gnüda menada tres le Canal inglesc.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Porimpó êl ma dër püces barches dla Royal Navy metüdes sö dlungia les rutes d'invajiun che podô ester, deache i amirai se temô ch'ares foss gnüdes afonades dal'ofensiva di fligri todësc.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: I metun man cun na spligaziun di planns dla Talia. La Talia ê dantadöt la "picia so" dla Germania y dl Iapan.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Ara â n esert plü debl y na marina plü debla, ince sc'ara â mefodër costruí cater barches nöies püch dan le scomenciamënt dla vera.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: I obietifs prinzipai dla Talia ê i Paisc africans. Por concuisté chi Paisc, essi adoré na basa da pié ia por les trupes, por che les trupes ess podü navighé tres le Mer Mediteran y tó ite l'Africa.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Porchël messâi gní lëdi dales bases y barches britaniches tl Egit. A per chës aziuns, n'ess les barches da vera talianes albü bria da ne fá nia d'ater.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Sëgn rovunse pro le Iapan. Le Iapan ê n stat isola, avisa coche la Gran Bretagna.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: I sotmarins é barches proietades da jí sot ega, y por sté dailó por n tëmp plü lunch.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: I sotmarins ê gnüs tuc tla Pröma vera mondiala y tla Secunda vera mondiala. Inlaota êi dër pëigri y ai stlopetâ ma dër püch lunc.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Al scomenciamënt dla vera viagiâi scialdi sura ega ia, mo canche i radars â metü man da se svilupé y da gní tres plü avisa ê i sotmarins gnüs sforzá da jí sot ega por evité da gní odüs.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: I sotmarins todësc gnô tlamá U-Boats. I todësc ê dër bogn da navighé y da fá funzioné sü sotmarins.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Por via de so suzes cun i sotmarins, minân che i todësc nen n'ess nia tröc de chi do la vera.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Sce! Le re Tutankhamun, val' iade nominé coche "Re Tut" o "Le Re möt", é un di resc dl vedl Egit plü conesciüs ti tëmps moderns.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Interessant él da odëi che tl'antichité ne gnôl nia araté tan important y al ne gnô gnanca reporté sön la maiú pert dles listes plü vedles di resc.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Porimpó l'â la scoverta de süa fossa tl 1922 fat deventé na zelebrité. Deperpo che tröpes fosses dl passé ê gnüdes arobades fora ê chësta fossa en pratica gnüda lasciada en pesc.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: La maiú pert di ogec sopolis cun Tutankhamun s'á mantigní bun, y lapró milesc de manufac realisá cun metai preziusc y peres rades.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Cun l'invenziun dles rodes da füs é i ciars assirs gnüs plü lisiers, plü asvelc, y arjigná miú da ti passé dant ai soldas y a d'atri ciars.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Les saites de sü baresć mortai ê bones da passé tres les armadöres di soldas aversars. Incër le 1000 dan Gejú Crist, á i Assirs introdüt la pröma ciavalaria.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Na ciavalaria é n esert che combat a ciaval. La sela n'ê nia ciamó gnüda inventada, porchël combatô la ciavalaria assira sön le spiné bluder de sü ciavai.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: I conesciun tröc politics, scienziá y artisć grecs. Poester é la porsona plü conesciüda de chësta cultura Omer, le poet verc liendar che á scrit dui capolaurs dla leteratöra greca: i poems Iliade y Odissea.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sofocle y Aristofan é dötaurela ciamó dramaturgs conesciüs y sü toc vëgn aratá danter les plü gran operes dla leteratöra mondiala.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: N ater grech conesciü é le matematich Pitagora, conesciü dantadöt por so teorema famus söles relaziuns danter les perts de triangui dales perts anfat.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Al é deplü stimes söl numer de porsones che baia hindi. Al vëgn sciazé ch'al é danter le secundo y le cuarto lingaz plü baié al monn.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Le numer de porsones de lingaz dla uma variëia sc'an cumpëda lapró o nia i dialec che é dër daimpró.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Les sciazades vá da 340 miliuns a 500 miliuns de porsones che le baia, y röia cina a 800 miliuns de porsones che é bones da capí le lingaz.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Le hindi y le urdu se somëia por le lessich mo se desfarenziëia tla scritöra; tles conversaziuns da vigni de se capësc les porsones che baia un di dui lingac de regola danter ëres.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Incër le 15ejim secul á l'Estonia setentrionala subí n'influënza sterscia da pert dla Germania.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: N valgügn patri todësc orô porté Chël Bel Dî plü daimpró dala jënt dl post, porchël ái inventé le lingaz leterar eston.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Al ê basé sön l'alfabet todësch y öna na lëtra "Õ/õ" é gnüda metüda lapró.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Cun le passé dl tëmp é tröpes parores imprestades dal todësch gnüdes assimilades. Chësc ê le scomenciamënt dl ilominism.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Do tradiziun jô le suzessur diretamënter pro i soldas do avëi rové la scora.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Mo Charles frecuentâ le Trinity College a Cambridge, olache al studiâ antropologia y archeologia y plü tert storia, arjunjon 2:2 (na nota plü bassa zënza lalt).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles ê le pröm mëmber dla familia reala britanica che â arjunt n titul de stüde.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: La Turchia europeica (la Tracia orientala o Rumelia sön la penisola balcanica) fej fora le 3% dl paisc.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Le raiun dla Turchia é lunch plü co 1.600 chilometri (1.000 milies) y lerch 800 km (500 milies), cun na forma plü o manco retangolara.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: La spersa dla Turchia, cun lapró i lec, stlüj ite 783,562 chilometri cuadrac (300,948 sq mi), de chisc é 755,688 metri cuadrac (291,773 sq mi) tla Asia sudozidentala y 23,764 chilometri cuadrac (9,174 sq mi) tla Europa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: La spersa dla Turchia é por estenjiun le 37ejim paisc plü gran dl monn y pó gní confrontada cun la Francia metropolitana y le Rëgn Uní metüs adöm.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: La Turchia é incertlada dal mer da trëi perts: le Mer Egeo a ozidënt, le Mer Fosch a nord y le Mer Mediteran a Süd.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Le Luxembourg á na storia lungia mo süa independënza vá derevers al 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Les perts atuales dl Belgio aldî pro le Luxembourg tl passé, mo rovâ pro le Belgio do la Revoluziun Belga di agn 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Le Luxembourg á tres porvé da resté n paisc neutral, mo al é gnü ocupé sides dala Pröma Vera dl Monn co dala Secunda dai Paisc Todësc.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Dl 1957 é le Luxembourg sté le mëmber fondadú de chë organisaziun conesciüda incö sciöche Uniun Europeica.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Le Drukgyal Dzong é na ruina de n fort y convënt budist tla pert plü alta dl Paro District (tl Paisc de Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Al vëgn dit che Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel ais cherié dl 1649 na fortificaziun por comemoré la devënta cuntra les forzes tibetan-mongoles.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Dl 1951 êl sté n medefüch insciö che ma n valgönes dles relicuies dl Drukgyal Dzong se â mantigní, sciöche la imaja de Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Do le medefüch é la fortificaziun gnüda presservada y sconada, restan öna dles atraziuns plü sensazionales dl Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Tratan le XVIII secul ê la Cambogia drucada danter dui vijins potënc, la Tailandia y le Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: I thais é roc ite tla Cambogia de plü iadi dl XVIII secul y dl 1772 ái desdrüt Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Ti ultims agn dl XVIII secul é ince i vietnamesc roc ite tla Cambogia.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Le dejedot porcënt di venezuelans é zënza laur y tröc de ëi y la maiú pert de chi che é ocupá laora tla economia informala.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Dui terc di venezuelans che laora le fej tl setur di sorvisc, prësc n chert laora tla industria y n cuint laora tla agricoltöra.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Na industria importanta por i venezuelans é le petröre, de chël che le paisc é n esportadú netto, ince sce ma un n porcënt laora tla industria dl petröre.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Adora tla independënza dla naziun á la esperiënza dl Urt Botanich de Singapur daidé trasformé la isola te na cité-urt tropicala.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Dl 1981 é Vanda Miss Joaquim, na orchidea ibrida, gnüda chirida fora sciöche ciüf nazional dl Paisc.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: De otober de vigni ann vëgnel feter 1,5 miliuns de erbivors jö di coi setentrionai sön les planöres meridionales, passan por le rü Mara, porvia dles plöies.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Y spo indô derevers tl nord tres l'ozidënt, indô passan ia le rü Mara, do les plöies de aurí.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Pro la regiun dl Serengeti aldel le Serengeti National Park, le Ngorongoro Coservation Area y le Maswa Game Reserve tla Tanzania y le Maasai Mara National Reserve tl Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Da imparé da cherié media interatifs vál debojëgn de abilités convenzionales y tradizionales, sciöche ince massaries imparades te cursc interatifs (storyboarding, audio y video editing, story telling, yi.i.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Le design interatif se damana che i revalutëis ostes ipoteses sön la produziun de media y che i imparëis da ponsé te na manira nia lineara.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Le design interatif se damana che les componëntes de n proiet se liëies öna cun la atra, mo che ares ais ince n significat sciöche unité despartida.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Le desvantaje di teleobietifs é che la complessité focala y le numer de elemënc di obietifs adoré da arjunje na varieté de lunghëza focala é cotan plü gran co por obietifs cun na destanza focala fissa.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Chësc problem vëgn tres mënder ciodiche i produturs de obietifs arjunj tres de mius standards tla produziun de obietifs.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Chësc á conzedü da fá cun i teleobietifs retrac de na cualité che pó gní confrontada cun chëra arjunta cun obietifs cun na destanza focala fissa.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: N ater desvantaje di teleobietifs é che la daurida mascimala (la velozité) di obietifs é por le plü mëndra.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Chësc fej a na manira che teleobietifs bunmarcé sides ri da adoré te condiziuns de pücia löm y zënza flash.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Un di problems plü frecuënc da convertí n film te n format DVD é le overscan.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: La maiú pert dles televijiuns é fates insciö da ti plajëi al gran publich.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Por chësta rajun é l'ur de döt ci che an vëiga tla televijiun taié söinsom, jödapé y dales perts.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Chësc vëgn fat por garantí che la imaja cüres döt le vidrel. A chësc ti dijon overscan.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Baldi vëgn i urs ince taiá canche an fej n DVD y sce i sottitui é tl video massa dlungia l'ur jödapé, ne vëgni nia mostrá deplëgn.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Le ciastel tipicamënter medieval á dadî incá ispiré la imaginaziun, descedan chedri de turniers, banchec y ciavalaria arturiana.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Ince da sté amesa de de vedles ruines milenares él saurí da descedé tla mënt i sonns y i tofs dles batalies oramai passades, da aldí le tlapernamënt di fers da ciaval sön le salajé y da tofé la tëma che vëgn sö dales porjuns.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Mo é nosta imaginaziun basada sön la realté? Y imprömadedöt ciodí gnô pa i ciastí fac sö? Co êsi pa dessigná y fac sö?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Sciöche al ê tipich por chël tëmp é Kirby Muxloe Castle plülere na ciasa fortificada co n dër ciastel.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Sü gragn vidri de spidl y sü mürs fins ne foss nia stá bogn da tigní bot tan dî a n atach miré.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Ti agn incër le 1480, canche Lord Hastings â metü man da le fá sö, ê le paisc relativamënter en pesc y an messâ ma se defëne da de pices bandes de malandrins che bondernâ intoronn.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: La balanza dles forzes ê n sistem cun chël che les naziuns europeiches porvâ da mantigní la sovranité nazionala de düc i stac europeics.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Le conzet ê chël che dötes les naziuns europeiches messâ porvé da evité che öna na naziun gniss potënta y porchël mudâ i governs nazionai gonot sües alianzes por mantigní la balanza.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: La vera de suzesciun spagnola é stada la pröma vera che â sciöche problem prinzipal chël da balanzé les forzes.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Chësc â dé dant na mudaziun importanta porvia che les forzes europeiches ne ess nia plü albü le pretest da ester veres religioses. Porchël é la Vera di Trënt'Agn stada la ultima vera definida vera religiosa.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Le tëmpl de Artemis a Efesus ê gnü desdrüt ai 21 de messé dl 356 dan Crist, cun n at de medefüch impizé da Herostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Aladô dla storia, ê süa motivaziun chëra da gní famus a vigni cost. I abitanc de Efeso, ofenüs, â detlaré ch'ai n‘ess mai registré so inom.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Le storich grech Strabo â plü tert scrit sö l'inom, coche i le conesciun aldedaincö. Le tëmpl ê gnü desdrüt la medema nöt che Alexander le Gran ê nasciü.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, da re, s'â pité da paié da fá sö danü le tëmp, mo süa oferta ê gnüda refodada. Dedô, canche Alexander ê mort, ê le tëmpl gnü fat sö danü tl 323 dan G.C.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Ciara che tüa man sides löcra le plü ch'ara vá deperpo che te atoches inant les notes coch'al alda - proa ince da ne fá nia movimënc cun tü dëic che ne vá nia debojëgn.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Insciö te stanciaraste le manco poscibl. Recordete ch'al n'é nia debojëgn da druché söles tastes cun tröpa forza por aumenté le volum, coche pro le clavier.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Pro i orghi da botuns, por aumenté le volum, drücheste le mantesc plü dassënn o plü debota.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Le mistizism é l'orëi arjunje na comunanza, n'identité, o na cosciënza sintida de na realté vera, de na divinité, verité spirituala o de Dî.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Le credënt aspirëia a n'esperiënza, intuiziun o na vijiun tla realté divina/tla divinité o divinités.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: I discepui ti vá do a na certa manira da vire, o a pratiches che dess nudrí chëstes esperiënzes.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Le mistizism pó gní desfarenzié da d'atres formes de religiun y adoraziun dal'importanza ch'an ti dá al vire te na manira personala y direta esperiënzes cosciëntes uniches dantadöt chëres che á n carater pazifich, sot, beat o cinamai estatich.
