text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Le sikhisim é na religiun dl subcontinënt indian. Al é nasciü tla regiun Punjab tl 15ejim secul do che na seta s'â destaché dala tradiziun indú.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: I sikhs arata che süa fede sides na religiun nia liada al induism, scebëgn ch'ai reconësc sües raisc y les tradiziuns indú.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: I sikhs ti dij Gurmat a süa religiun, che por punjabi ó dí "le tru dl guru". Le guru é n aspet fondamental de dötes les religiuns indianes, mo tl sikhism ál ciafé na te importanza da deventé le cör dla fede Sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: La religiun é gnüda metüda sö tl 15ejim secul da Guru Nanak (1469–1539). Al é spo gnü do nü gurus.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Te jügn dl 1956, indere, ê les impormetüdes de Krushchev gnüdes metüdes ala proa canche revoltes de lauranc tla Polonia, che protestâ cuntra la mancianza de patüc da mangé y i paiamënc taiá, s'â trasformé te na protesta generala cuntra le comunism.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Ince sce Krushchev â ala fin mené ciars armá por restabilí l'ordin, âl conzedü val' ghiranza economica y al â lascé pro che le popolar Wladyslaw Gomulka gniss nominé pröm minister.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: La zivilté dla Val de Indus ê na zivilté dl'Eté dl brom tl subcontinënt indian dl nord-vest, che tolô ite la maiú pert de chël che é aldedaincö le Pachistan y n valgönes regiuns a nord-vest dl'India y dl nord-ost dl Afghanistan.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: La zivilisaziun s'â svilupé ti fops dl rü Indus da chël ch'ara á ciafé l'inom.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Ince sce n valgügn studiá arata che, dal momënt che la zivilté viô ince ti fops dl rü Sarasvati, aldedaincö assuié fora, essera pordërt gnü messü tlamada zivilisaziun Indus-Sarasvati, d'atri deperpo ti dij zivilisaziun Harappan aladô de Harappa, le pröm de sü sic che é gnü ciavé fora ti agn 1920.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: La natöra militaristica dl Imper roman á porté pro al svilup dl progres tla medejina.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Doturs gnô cherdá sot dal imparadú Augustus y formâ cinamai la pröma trupa sanitara romana por i intervënc do les batalies.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: I chirurgs conesciô deplü sedatifs, cun lapró la morfina trata fora dales somënzes dl pavé y scopalamina dales somënzes de erbes.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Ai gnô esperc dles amputaziuns por sconé i paziënc dala cancrena y ince dles fasciadöres a presciun y dles pinzëtes da arteries por archité sö le sanch.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Te deplü secui á l'Imper roman arjunt de gragn progresc tla medejina portan pro a gran pert dl savëi d'aldedaincö.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: L'origam "Pureland" é n origam cun la limitaziun ch'an pó le lobrí adöm ma un n iade, ara ne vá nia da le lobrí adöm te na manira plü complessa, coche sön la pert rodosa, mo ma tles perts plü scëmples.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Al ê gnü svilupé da John Smith ti agn 1970 por daidé chi che â pücia esperiënza da lobrí adöm o â abilités motoriches limitades.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: I mituns svilupëia scialdi adora na cosciënza dla raza y di stereotips raziai y chisc stereotips raziai influenzëia le comportamënt.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Por ejëmpl, i mituns che s'identifichëia cun na mendranza raziala che, aladô de n stereotip, se stënta te scora, é portá da se fá ert te scora pornanche ai é vëgn alsavëi le stereotip lié a süa etnia.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace é le terzo sit internet plü conesciü ti Stac Unis y á al momënt 54 miliuns de profii.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Chisc sic internet vëgn dër chiris sö, dantadöt tl setur dl'istruziun.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Al é aspec positifs te chisc sic internet, coche danterater la poscibilité da imposté saurí na plata dla classa che pó tó ite blogs, videos, fotografies y d'atres funziuns.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: An röia saurí sön chësta plata ma cun öna n'adressa web, che é saurida da recordé y da dé ite ince por chi studënc che podess se stenté da adoré la tastadöra o da scrí.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Ara pó gní personalisada por ch'ara sides saurí da lí y implü cun deplü o manco corusc, coch'an ó.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Le desturb da defizit d'atenziun "é n sindrom neurologich olache i trëi sintoms classics che le definësc é l'impulsivité, la desconzentraziun y l'iperativité o l'energia surafora".
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Al n'é nia na dejabilité da imparé, mo al é n desturb tl imparé; al "reverda da 3 a 5 porcënt de düc i mituns, plü o manco él coche 2 miliuns de mituns americans".
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Mituns cun DDA se stënta da se conzentré sön cosses coche i laurs de scora, mo ai é bogn da se conzentré sön cosses che ti sá beles coche soghé, ti ciaré ai dessëgns animá preferis o scrí frases zënza interpunziun.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Chisc mituns é portá da rové ti cajins, deache "ai se lascia ite te comportamënc prigorusc, ai fej vera y provochëia les autorités" por stimolé so ciorvel, che ne pó nia gní stimolé cun les metodes normales.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Le DDA condizionëia les relaziuns cun mituns dla medema eté deache i atri mituns n'é nia bogn da capí ciodich'ai se comporta o scrí te chë manira, o che le livel de maturité é atramënter.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Deache l'abilité da tó sö le savëi y da imparé é mudé coch'al é gnü descrit dessura, s'ál ince mudé l'andamënt coche le savëi gnô tut sö.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: La manira da rové pro les informaziuns ê n'atra. An ne drucâ nia plü söla memoria individuala, mo an ti dê plü pëis al'abilité da se recordé n test.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Belavisa, él gnü a s'al dé cun le Renascimënt de gragn mudamënc tla manira da ti jí pormez al imparé y ala difujiun dl savëi.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Atramënter co i atri primac, n'adora i ominig nia plü les mans da se möie inant, da porté pëisc o da se sbinghé da n lëgn al ater.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Les mans y i pisc dl scimpanzé é gragn y lunc anfat coche conseguënza che les mans tëgn sö le pëis dl corp canch'ai vá söles conëdles.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: La man dla porsona é plü cörta co le pe, cun falanges plü indërt.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: I fossii di osc dles mans, de dui o trëi miliuns de agn, mostra sö che la man s'á spezialisé da meso por se möie inant a n meso por brancé ite.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Valun arata che esperimenté tröc somi tlers gaujá te na manira artifiziala pois ester gonot dër sfadius.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: La gauja prinzipala de chësc fenomen é chëra che i soms tlers aumënta le tëmp danter les fases REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Cun manco fases REM vigni nöt vëgn chësta situaziun, olach'an dorm davëi y le corp recuperëia, tres demanco tan da deventé n problem.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Chësc é avisa tan sfadius coche sce te descedasseste fora vigni vint o trënta menüc y te ciarasses la televijiun.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: La faziun depënn da tan gonot che to ciorvel proa da somié tler vigni nöt.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Les cosses ne butâ nia por i talians tl nord dl’Africa feter dal mëteman. Gnanca n'edema do la detlaraziun de vera dla Talia, ai 10 de jügn dl 1940, â i britanics dl önejim regimënt tut posses dla fortëza Capuzzo tla Libia.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Tratan na misciun a ost de Bardia, â i inglesc abiné le injinier ce dla diejima armada taliana, le general Lasticci.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Ai 28 de jügn êl gnü copé adinfal da na stlopetada da sües trupes le marescial Italo Balbo, le governadú general dla Libia y suzessur poscibl de Mussolini, tratan ch'al sbarcâ a Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Le sport modern dla scherma vëgn pratiché sön deplü liví, dai studënc universitars ales competiziuns profescionales y olimpiches.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Chësc sport vëgn dantadöt pratiché da dui concorënc che se bata l'un l'ater.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Le golf é n jüch olache i sogadus tira les cogores tles büjes cun na maza.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Tratan na roda normala vëgnel soghé dejedot büjes, cun i sogadus che mët man de regola dala pröma büja dl percurs y röia ala dejedotejima.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Al davagna le sogadú che adora le mënder numer de colps, o de trates cun la maza, da porté a fin le percurs.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: La partida vëgn sogada sön pre y l'erba incër la büja ia vëgn siada plü cörta y ara vëgn definida "green".
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: La sort de turism che vëgn dant le plü sovënz é plü sigü chëra che la majera pert dla jënt coliëia cun l'idea de iade: le turism de palsa.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Chësc sozed canche la jënt vá te n post dër atramënter da süa vita da vigni de por se lascé ia y se la lascé jí buna.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Les spones dl mer, i parcs de devertimënt y i posć da aciampé é i posć plü vijitá dai sciori dl tëmp lëde.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Canche le fin dla vijita te n post spezifich é chël da imparé a conësce süa storia y cultura, spo vëgn chësta sort de turism definí turism cultural.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: I turisć pó vijité deplü posć d’interes de n paisc avisa o tó la dezijiun da se conzentré ma sön na zona sora.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Ince i colonisć, che â odü chësta ativité, â damané do aiüt.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Les trupes che á daidé les posiziuns che jô inant ê le pröm y le terz regimënt dl New Hampshire, metü adöm da 200 ëi che stô al comane di colonei John Stark y James Reed (trami é dedô gnüs generai).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: I ëi de Stark se â metü sö dlungia la si tl punt plü a nord dla posiziun di colonisć.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Canche la marea bassa â daurí n passaje dlungia le rü Mystic tl nord-ost dla penisola, âi tosc arlungé la si cuntra nord cun n pice mür de pera che jô ite tl ega y rovâ söla spona dl mer.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley o Stark â mazé jö n pe te tera a zirca 100 pisc (30 metri) dalunc dala si y â ordiné da ne stlopeté nia cina che i soldas regolars ne l’â nia superé.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Le plann american ê da coordiné i atacs da trëi direziuns desvalies.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Por ne lascé nia rové adalerch n sostëgn implü, fajess le general John Cadwalder pié ia na manovra de deviaziun cuntra les trupes britaniches a Borduntown.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Le general James Ewing ess condüt 700 soldas dla milizia sura le rü ia a Trenton Ferry, por surantó spo le control dl punt söl rü Assunpink y ti impedí ales trupes nemiches da s'un sciampé.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: La forza de assalt prinzipala, metüda adöm da 2.400 ëi, foss jüda sura le rü ia 9 milies a nord de Trenton, por se partí sö spo te dui grups, un comané da Greene y l’ater da Sullivan, insciö da mené n atach dan da l'orí dla doman.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Passan dala maratona de n chert de milia a chëra de mesa milia, vëgn la velozité manco importanta y la condiziun na dërta nezescité.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Sambëgn mëss n podist de pröma classa che salta la mesa maratona, un che pó bate i dui menüc, ester bun da salté dër debota, mo la condiziun mëss gní alenada a vigni cost.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Jí a salté por le ciampopré tratan l’invern, colié cun eserzizi te palestra por la pert dessura dl corp, é la miú preparaziun por la sajun da salté.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Na bona alimentaziun ne é nia assa por fá prestaziuns de livel alt, mo ara miorëia dassënn le bëgnester di atlec jogn.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Mantigní na balanza energetica sana, mëte en pratica usanzes de idrataziun efiziëntes y capí i aspec desvalis dles pratiches de integraziun pó daidé i atlec da mioré sües prestaziuns y da aumenté le devertimënt da fá sport.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: La mesa maratona é n sport scialdi püch cer; al é indere tröpes malintenüdes por ci che reverda n valgönes atrezadöres che vá debojëgn por tó pert.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: I produc pó gní cumprá aladô dles nezescités, mo la maiú pert de chisc ne á feter degun influs söles prestaziuns.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: I atlec pó araté da avëi plü ion n produt ince canch'al ne dá degun vantaje concret.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: L’atom pó gní conscidré un di elemënc costrutifs fondamentai de döta la materia.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Ara se trata de n'entité dër complessa che contëgn, aladô dl model scemplifiché de Bohr, n zënter incertlé da eletrons, n pü’ sciöche i planëc che roda incër le sorëdl ia - ciara la figöra 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Le nojel atomich é metü adöm da döes particoles: i neutrons y i protons.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: I protons á na ciaria eletrica positiva, deperpo ne á i neutrons degöna ciaria. I eletrons á na ciaria eletrica negativa.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Denanco ejaminé la vitima mësseste impröma ispezioné le post dl delit por garantí tüa segurëza.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Al vá debojëgn da tigní cunt dla posiziun dla vitima canch'an ti röia pormez y de düc i sëgns d'avertimënt automatics.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Sc'i ves fajëis me tratan ch'i daidëis, podesses fá gní la situaziun ma da peso.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Le stüde á ciafé fora che la depresciun, la tëma y le pinsier catastrofich fej da mediadus danter le dolur y le impedimënt pro paziënc cun me de spiné.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Ma la faziun dl pinsier catastrofich, y nia dla depresciun y dla tëma, depenô da sesciuns edemales regolares de PA strotorada.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Chi che â tut pert a n'ativité regolara â albü debojëgn de n majer sostëgn aladô dla perzeziun negativa dl dolur, insciö da reconësce les desfarëntes danter le dolur cronich y le malester che vëgn dal movimënt fisich normal.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: L'odüda, o la capazité dl odëi, depënn dai organs di sënsc dl sistem visif o dai edli.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Al é deplü strotöres de edli, olache la complessité müda aladô di bojëgns dl organism.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Les strotöres desvalies á capazités desfarëntes, ares é sensibles a deplü lunghëzes d'ona y ares á forzes dl edl desvalies, ares se damana ince n'atra elaboraziun por ti dé n significat ai dac y ai numeri desfarënc por funzioné indortöra.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Na popolaziun é n grup de organisms de na certa sort te n raiun geografich spezifich.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Canche düc i individuums de na popolaziun é medemi por ci che reverda n sëgn fenotipich particolar, ti vëgnel dit monomorfics.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Canche les porsones á deplü variantes de n cer sëgn carateristich, ti vëgnel dit polimorfics.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Ince les colonies de formies legionares marcia y fej coa te fases desvalies.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Tla fasa nomada marcia les formies legionares de nöt y se archita por palsé ia por le de.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: La colonia mët man na fasa nomada canche le patüc da mangé a desposiziun vëgn tres demanco. Tratan chësta fasa fej la colonia coes temporanes che vëgn mudades jö vigni de.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Vignöna de chëstes prozesciuns nomades o marces döra incër 17 dis.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Ci é pa na zelula? La parora zelula vëgn dal latin "cella", che ó dí "picia ciamena", y é gnüda adorada le pröm iade da n microscopist che osservâ la strotöra dl corch.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: La zelula é l'unité de basa de dötes les creatöres y düc i organisms é metüs adöm da öna o deplü zelules.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Les zelules é tan fondamentales y dezisives por le stüde dla vita che ares vëgn gonot definides "i cadrí dla vita".
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Le sistem di nerfs scona les funziuns dl corp menan i impulsc di nerfs te döt le corp insciö da mantigní le flus dl sanch en movimënt y lëde.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Chisc impulsc di nerfs pó gní mená tan debota te döt le corp da stravardé le corp da prighi potenziai.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Les vëntes vëgn a s'al dé te n raiun mënder co chël de d'atri vënc stersc, mo ares pó desdrüje döt ci ch'ares incunta sön so tru.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Les vëntes desraijëia i lëgns, scherza les brëies fora di frabicac y sciurá sö i auti tl'aria. Le 2% dles vëntes plü violëntes döra plü co trëi ores.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Chëstes tempestes da temëi á vënc che arjunj i 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: La porsona costruësc y adora les linses d'ingrandimënt bele da milesc d’agn incá.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: I pröms dër telescops é indere gnüs cheriá tl’Europa ala fin dl 16ejim secul.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Chisc telescops adorâ na combinaziun de döes löms por lascé odëi i ogec dalunc plü daimpró y plü gragn.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: L’avidité y l’egoism fajará dagnora pert de nos y la natöra dla colaboraziun nes dij che canche la maioranza nen á dainciará sarál dagnora da nen davagné deplü tl tëmp cört se comportan te na manira egoistica.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: An spera che la maiú pert dla jënt sides bona da capí che la miú dezijiun alalungia é chëra da lauré deboriada cun d’atri.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Tröc somiëia le de canche les porsones podará jí devers de n'atra stëra y descurí d’atri monns, n valgügn se damana ci ch'al é lafora, d’atri mina che i extraterestri o d’atres formes de vita pois vire sön n'atra planta.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Mo sc'al ess da sozede, ne sozedarál bonamënter nia por n pez. Les stëres é tan sparpagnades fora ch'al é miliarg de chilometri danter les stëres "vijines".
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Üsc pronus sará forsc n de fora dal monn y se damanará chi che ê sü antenac?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: I tiers é metüs adöm da n gröm de zelules. Ai dlot le patüc da mangé y le digerësc daite. La maiú pert di tiers é bogn da se möie.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Ma i tiers á n ciorvel (ince sce nia düc i tiers ne l’á: les meduses n’á por ejëmpl degun ciorvel).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: I tiers é sön döt le planët. Ai ciava tl grunt, noda ti ozeans y jora sö al cil.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: La zelula é l'unité strotorala y funzionala plü picera de n organism (creatöra) che vir.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Zelula vëgn dala parora latina "cella", che ó dí picera ciamena.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Sce te ti ciares ales creatöres cun le microscop, odaraste che ares é metüdes adöm da de pici cuadrac o cogores.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, n biologh inglesc, â odü de pici cadrí tl corch cun n microscop.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Ai ciarâ fora sciöche ciamenes. Al é sté le pröm da osservé zelules mortes.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: I elemënc y les combinaziuns pó passé da n stat al ater zënza mudé.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: L’azot tl stat gasus á ciamó les medemes proprietés dl azot licuid. Tl stat licuid él plü densité, mo i molecüi é dagnora i medemi.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: N ater ejëmpl é l'ega. La combinaziun dl'ega é metüda adöm da dui atoms de idrogen y un de ossigen.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: La strotöra di molecüi é la medema, anfat sc'ara se trata de n gas, n licuid o n solid.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Ince sce so stat fisich pó mudé, resta le stat chimich anfat.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Le tëmp é val’ che nes incërtla y influenzëia vigni nosta aziun, mo al é ri da capí.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Le tëmp é gnü inrescí da studiá de religiun, de filosofia y de sciënza por milesc de agn.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: I viun le tëmp sciöche na secuënza de evënc che vá dal dagní inant tl passé tres le presënt.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Le tëmp é ince la manira cun chëra ch’i metun a confrunt la dorada (lunghëza) di evënc.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Os instësc podëis mosoré le tëmp che passa osservan la repetiziun de n evënt ziclich. N evënt ziclich é val' che vëgn dant danü tres indô.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Aldedaincö vëgn i computers adorá por mancioré les imajes y i videos.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Ara vá da fá animaziuns avisa söi computers y chësta sort de animaziun vëgn tres plü adorada tla televijiun y ti films.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: La musiga vëgn gonot tuta sö adoran computers dassënn svilupá por lauré fora y moscedé adöm i sonns.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Tl dejenüejim y tl vintejim secul gnôl miné che i pröms abitanc dla Zelanda Nöia foss i Maori, n popul che jô a ciacia de dër gragn vicí, a chi ch'an ti dijô moas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: La teoria á spo porté dant l'idea che le popul Maori é emigré dala Polinesia cun na gran flota y ti á tut sotfora la Zelanda Nöia ai Moriori, meton sö na sozieté da paur.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Evidënzes nöies porta indere a ponsé che i Moriori ê n grup de Maori dla tera frëma che dala Zelanda Nöia ê migrá söles isoles Chatham, svilupan na süa cultura dla pesc particolara.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Al ê ince n'atra tribú söles isoles de Chatram. Chisc ê i Maori che ê emigrá dala Zelanda Nöia.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Ai se â tlamé Moriori y do n valgönes batalies ési ala fin düc gnüs copá jö.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Les porsones trates ite dezens alalungia á daidé aprijé nostes forzes y nostes pasciuns, valutan deperpo cun redlëza les dificoltés y cinamai i falimënc.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Tratan che les porsones partî sües stories personales, familiares y d'organisaziun, unse ciafé informaziuns de valur sön le passé y sön valgönes personalités che á influenzé, tl bun o tl mal, la cultura dl'organisaziun.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Scemia che la conescënza dla storia personala ne comporta nia la conescënza dla cultura, dëidera porimpó les porsones da capí ci pert che ares á albü tla storia tl’organisaziun.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Tl valuté i suzesc y dé pro i falimënc, les porsones singules y la totalité di partezipanc vëgn sura di valurs, i traverc y les forzes che tira inant l’organisaziun.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Te chësc caje, cherdé a mënt i caji de politiches comerziales da denant y i suzesc che é gnüs do á daidé la jënt da se daurí a mudaziuns nöies y a na direziun nöia por la dlijia locala.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Chëstes stories de suzes á diminuí les tëmes dl mudamënt, cherian tl medemo momënt manires da ponsé positives devers dl mudamënt tl dagní.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: I schemesc de pinsier che vá a öna é tecniches de ressoluziun di problems che mët adöm idees o ciamps desvalis por ciafé na soluziun.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Le punt tle de chësta manira da ponsé é la velozité, la logica y la prezijiun, mo ince l'identificaziun di fac, aplican danü les tecniches esistëntes y la racoiüda de informaziuns.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Le fatur plü important de chësta manira de ponsé é: al é ma öna na resposta dërta. I ponsëis ma a döes respostes, iüst chëra dërta o chëra falada.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Chësta sort de pinsier ti vá do a n valgönes prozedöres scientifiches o usuales.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Les porsones che á chësta sort de pinsier á n pinsier logich, ares sciafia da memorisé schemesc, da ciafé soluziuns ai problems y da ti ester manëcia ales proes scientifiches.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: La porsona é de gran lungia la sort che s'intopa le plü da lí i pinsiers de d’atri.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Chësc ó dí ch’i sun bogn da odëi danfora cun suzes ci che d’atres porsones sënt, pënsa, mina, sá o dejidrëia.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Danter chëstes capazités é chëra da capí les intenziuns de d'atri de gran importanza. Ara nes pormët da tlarí les ambivalënzes poscibles dles aziuns dl corp.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Por ejëmpl, sce te esses da odëi zacai che spaca le vider de n auto, podesseste bonamënter miné ch'al sides tl laur da arobé l’auto de n forest.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Al messess gní interpreté atramënter sc'al ess pordü les tles dl auto y sc'al instës ess porvé da rumpí ite so auto.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: Le MRI se basëia sön n fenomen dla fisica tlamé ressonanza magnetica nucleara (RMN), descurí ti agn '30 da Felix Bloch (che laurâ tl Université de Stanford) y da Edward Purcell (dl'Université de Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Te chësta ressonanza porta le ciamp magnetich y les ones radio i atoms da mené fora segnai radio debli.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Tl 1970 á le dotur y inrescidú scientifich Raymond Damadian descurí les fondamëntes dl'adoranza dla ressonanza magnetica tres imajes coche stromënt de diagnosa di doturs.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Cater agn dedô êl gnü conzedü n brevët, le pröm dl monn tl ciamp dla ressonanza magnetica.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Tl 1977 á le dotur Damadian porté a piz la costruziun dl pröm scanner por la ressonanza magnetica ”integrala”, a chël ch'al ti a dé inom ”Indomitable”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: La comunicaziun nia sincronica dá tëmp por ponsé do y respogne ai atri.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Al ti pormët ai studënc da lauré aladô de so ritm y da manajé la velozité dles informaziuns didatiches.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Implü é les limitaziuns dl tëmp mëndres, cun la poscibilité de orars de laur flessibli. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: L'adoranza de internet y dl World Wide Web ti pormët ai studënc da avëi azes ales informaziuns te vigni momënt.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: I studënc pó ince ti fá domandes ai dozënc te vigni momënt tratan le de y ciafé de regola respostes scialdi dër asveltes, impede jí de porsona ala proscima discusciun.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: La manira da imparé postmoderna é lëdia da prinzips assoluc. Al n’é nia ma öna na manira da imparé che vel.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Al ne é belimpunt nia ma öna na dërta cossa da imparé. Le imparé vëgn a s'al dé tres l'esperiënza danter le studënt y la conescënza portada dant.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Nosta esperiënza da sëgn – cun düc i programs dla televijiun che á da nen fá cun le pastelné da ciasa, la presentaziun de informaziuns y le imparé – spliga chësc punt.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Tröc de nos é ausá da ti ciaré a n program dla televijiun che nes informëia sön n prozes o n'esperiënza olach'i ne tolarán mai pert o ne aplicarán mai chëra conescënza.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: I ne fajarán mai la revijiun de n auto, i ne fajarán mai na fontana te nosc urt, i ne fajarán mai n iade tl Perú por ejaminé les rovines vedles, o i ne dortorarán mai sö la ciasa de nosc vijin.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Por mirit dla rëi di cabli de fira de spidl sotmarins devers dl’Europa y le satelit a banda leria á la Groenlandia n bun coliamënt y le 93% dla popolaziun á azes a internet.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Osc hotel o osc ostí (sc'i stais sura nöt te na ciasa di gesć o privata) á bonamënter le Wi-Fi o n computer colié cun internet y i ciafarëis te vigni stabilimënt n bar che á internet o n post olach'al é le Wi-Fi publich.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Sciöche bele dit, scebëgn che la parora "eschimesc" vëgn ciamó azetada ti Stac Unis, ne vëgnera nia tuta sö bun dales popolaziuns artiches fora dai Stac Unis, dantadöt tl Canada.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Ince sce chësta parora pó gní adorada dales porsones dl post dla Groenlandia, messess chëres da foradecá evité da la adoré.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: I aborigens dla Groenlandia se á metü inom Inuit tl Canada y Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), n groenlandesc, tla Groenlandia.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: La criminalité y le malcontënt cuntra i foresć en general ne é feter nia conesciüs tla Groenlandia. Ince tles cités n’él degönes "zones prigoroses".
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Le frëit é forsc le su dër prigo che la jënt nia arjignada mëss afronté.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Sc'i jëis a ciaré la Groenlandia tratan les sajuns frëides (tignin cunt che plü ch'an vá cuntra nord, plü ch'al vëgn frëit), él fondamental da se tó para guant bindebó cialt.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: I dis dër lunc da d’isté pó condüje a problems de sonn y porchël ince de sanité.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Tratan l'isté él ince da mëte averda ales zanzares nordiches. Ince sc'ares ne taca nia maraties, póres jí söi nerf.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Scebëgn che l'economia de San Francisco depënn da süa condiziun de atraziun turistica internazionala, é süa economia impó desvalia.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: I seturs de laur plü importanc é i sorvisc profescionai, le govern, la finanza, le comerz y le turism.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: La musiga, i films y la cultura popolara á gonot porté dant la cité, contribuin da fá conësce la cité y sü monumënc sura döt le monn.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco á svilupé na infrastrotöra turistica dër grana, cun tröc hotí, ostaries y strotöres por congresc ezelëntes.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco é ince un di mius posć dl paisc por le mangé asiatich: corean, thailandesc, indian y iapanesc.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: N iade a Walt Disney World rapresentëia n pelegrinaje important por tröpes families americanes.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Por jí a ti ciaré vál de regola debojëgn da joré cina tl aeroport internazional de Orlando, jí cun la coriera devers de n hotel Disney söl post, resté apresciapüch n'edema tl areal dla Disney y gní zoruch a ciasa.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Al é n gröm de poscibilités danman, mo chësta resta ci che la maiú pert dla jënt mina canch’ara baia da "jí a Disney World".
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Tröpes chertes venüdes online tres plates web de astes sciöche eBay o Craigslist é chertes da deplü dis che vel por deplü parcs adorades ma en pert.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Ince sc'al é na pratica dër conesciüda, vëgnera proibida dala Disney: les chertes ne vá nia da dé inant.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Por se lascé jö cun la tënda sot le ur dl Grand Canyon vál debojëgn de na autorisaziun por le hinterland.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Les autorisaziuns é limitades por sconé le canyon y ares vëgn metüdes a desposiziun le pröm de dl mëis, cater mëisc dan le mëis de scomenciamënt.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: A chësta manira vëgnel metü a desposiziun na autorisaziun por le hinterland por vigni de de ma dal pröm de jená inant.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: I posć dles zones plü conesciüdes, sciöche le Bright Angel Campground dlungia le Phantom Ranch, é scialdi suraciariá de domandes dades jö le pröm de de daurida dles prenotaziuns.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Por les lizënzes resservades a chi che vá a pe él preodü n numer limité de autorisaziuns, metüdes a desposiziun a chi che röia adalerch denant.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Jí tl Südafrica cun l’auto é na manira straordinara por amiré döta la belëza dl raiun mo ince por arjunje localités che ne é zënza nia da ciafé ti itinerars turistics da dagnora.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Cun na planificaziun avisa poste le fá cun n auto normal, mo n auto che tira sön 4 rodes vëgn dër aconsié y tröc posć vá da arjunje ma cun n auto che á les rodes plü alalt.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Canch'i arjignëis ca le iade tignide a mënt che l’Africa dl Süd é bëgn n paisc stabil, mo che nia düc i paisc vijins ne l’é.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: I recuisic y i cosć di visums müda aladô di paisc y depënn dal paisc de provegnënza.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Vigni paisc á ince leges spezifiches che dá dant ci stromënc de emergënza che ó ester te auto.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls é na cité che é tla pert vest de Zimbabwe, iadelá dal confin cun Livingstone, tl Zambia, y dlungia Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: La cité é atira dlungia i pisciadus, che é l'atraziun prinzipala, mo chësta destinaziun turistica conesciüda pita sides a chi che chir aventöres co a chi che ó odëi la cité tröpes oportunités da sté sura nöt por deplü dis.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Tla sajun dles plöies (da novëmber cina merz) gnará le volum d’ega maiú y i pisciadus sará plü sensazionai.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Te vëgnes dessigü mol sce te passes ia le rü o sce te vas a pe do i trus dlungia i pisciadus.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Dal'atra pert, avisa deache le volum d'ega é tan alt, ne vára nia da odëi i pisciadus, propi por gauja de döta chë ega!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Fossa de Tutankhamon (KV62). KV62 é plü dessigü la fossa plü conesciüda tla valada, le post de descurida de Howard Carter, tl 1922, dla sopoltöra reala feter co intiera dl re jonn.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: En confrunt ala gran pert dles atres fosses reales, ne mirita indere la fossa de Tutankhamon feter gnanca da gní odüda, tan picera y püch decorada éra.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Chi che á interes da odëi sciöche la mumia é gnüda danejada tratan ch'an â porvé da la trá fora de scrin s'un tolará a mal, deach'al é ma le ce y les sciables da odëi.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Les richëzes dla fossa daspavënt beles n’é nia plü daite, mo ares é gnüdes portades tl Museum dl Egit a Cairo.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: I turisć che á püch tëmp a desposiziun fajess damí da passé le tëmp inzai d'ater.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km a süd-vest de Siem Reap. Chësc tëmpl söinsom le col é gnü fat sö ala fin dl non secul, tratan le rëgn dl re Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Al paia la möia da jí söl col por l’atmosfera scöra dl tëmpl y l'odüda söl lech Tonle Sap.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Jí a vijité le sit se lascia saurí combiné cun n iade cun la barca söl lech.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Por jí ite tl tëmpl vál debojëgn dl Angkor Pass, porchël no te desmentié da te tó para le passaport canche te vas devers dl Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Ierusalem é la capitala y la cité plü grana de Israel, ince sce la maiú pert di atri paisc y les Naziuns Unides ne la reconësc nia sciöche la capitala de Israel.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: La cité vedla söi coi dla Iudea á na storia afascinanta che tol ite milesc de agn.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: La cité é sacra por les trëi religiuns monoteistes – ebraism, cristianejim y islam – y vëgn adorada coche zënter spiritual, religius y cultural.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Por gauja dl significat religius dla cité y dantadöt di tröc sic dla Cité Vedla, é Ierusalem öna dles destinaziuns turistiches prinzipales te Israel.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Ierusalem á n gröm de posć d’interes storich, archeologich y cultural, sciöche ince zëntri comerziai, bars y ostaries plëgns de vita y de jënt.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: L'Ecuador ghira che i zitadins cubans ciafes na lëtra d’invit denanco jí ite tl Ecuador tres i aeroporc internazionai o i punc d’azes al confin.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Chësta lëtra mëss gní legalisada dal Minister por i afars cun l'ester dl Ecuador y se tigní ite a n valgügn recuisic spezifics.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Chisc recuisic é gnüs dá dant por garantí n flus de migraziun organisé danter i dui paisc.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: I zitadins cubans che á na cherta vërda di Stac Unis mëss jí da n consulat dl Ecuador por ti damané da gní alediá da chësc recuisit.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Le passaport mëss ester varënt por almanco 6 mëisc do ch'an é piá ia por le iade. Por desmostré la dorada dla sojornanza vál debojëgn de na cherta de iade da jí y da gní zoruch.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Les rodes é plü economiches por i grups plü gragn, porchël sc'i sëis susc o cun un n compagn, porvede da incunté d’atres porsones y da formé n grup de cater o sis porsones por ciafé n prisc a ce a bunmarcé.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Mo de chësc ne mësseste nia te cruzié, deache gonot vëgn i sciori mená inant y zoruch por fá plëgns i auti.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Al pé plütosc ch'al sides na manira da ingiané la jënt y ti fá crëie da messëi paié deplü.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Chësta munt che se avërj sö delá dal punt plü a nord dl Machu Picchu é gonot le sotfunz de tröpes fotos dles rovines.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Da ti ciaré da sotsö ára n aspet n pü’ da temëi y le jí sö é ërt y da stancé, mo les porsones cun na forma fisica valgamia bona messess ti ester te zirca 45 menüc.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Dlungia na gran pert dl percurs fora él scalins de pera y ti toc plü ërc pita les cordes d’aciá n punt de sostëgn.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Dit chësc, aspetedeves da fá fadia y metede averda ti toc plü ërc, dantadöt canch'ai é moi, dal momënt ch’ai pó gní te n iade prigorusc.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Dlungia la piza él n pice ander bindebó bas y scialdi strënt che mëss gní passé ia.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Por jí a odëi i posć y la fauna dles Galapagos vëgnel aconsié da fá n iade cun la barca, avisa sciöche Charles Darwin â fat tl 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Passa 60 bastimënc passa söles eghes dles Galapagos, cun dimenjiuns che vá dai 8 ai 100 passajiers.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: La maiú pert dla jënt prenotëia so post cotan danfora (deache les barches é gonot plënes tratan la sajun alta).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Assigurëiete che le meso cun chël che te prenotëies ais nu dles Galapagos y s'un capësces fora de na gran varieté de bastimënc.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: A chësta manira jará üsc interesc y/o üsc limic particolars a öna cun le bastimënt plü dërt por os.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Dan la gnüda di spagnoi tl 16ejim secul ê le Cile dl nord sot le domëne di Inca, deperpo che i aborigens dl’Araucania (Mapuche) viô tla pert zentrala y dl süd.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: I Mapuche é ince stá un di ultims grups dl post independënc dl'America che ne é nia gnüs daldöt trac ite tla dominaziun spagnola cina do l’independënza dl Cile.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Ince sce le Cile â detlaré l’independënza tl 1810 (amesa les veres de Napoliun che â lascé la Spagna zënza n govern che funzionass por n per de agn alalungia), ne ê la devënta dezisiva söi spagnoi nia gnüda arjunta cina l'ann 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: La Republica Dominicana (por spagnol: República Dominicana) é n paisc di Caraibi che é söla pert orientala dl’isola de Hispaniola, che alda ince pro Haiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Fora dles spones de saurun blanch y les contrades da munt á le paisc la plü vedla cité europeica dl'America, aldedaincö pert de Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: L’isola é naota gnüda abitada dai Taìnos y dai Caribes. I Caribes ê n popul che baiâ le Arawakan y che ê rové adalerch incër le 10.000 d.G.C.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Tl tëmp de püc agn do la gnüda di esploradus europeics ê la popolaziun Tainos gnüda smendrida dassënn dai concuistadus spagnoi.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Aladô de Fray Bertomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias), danter le 1492 y le 1498 á i concuistadus spagnoi copé incër 100.000 Taínos.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Chësc post ê l'atrium de n convënt dl 17ejim secul, de chël che le Templo de San Diego é le su frabicat che se á mantigní.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Sëgn funzionëiel sciöche plaza zentrala y al é tres tröpes cosses che vëgn fates, de de y de nöt.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Al é zacotan de restoranc incër urt ia y domisdé y dassëra vëgnel tigní conzerc debann sön le paiun zentral.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Alea dl baje). Dui soras separá ma da 69 zentimetri é la ciasa de na vedla liënda d'amur.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Por n valgönes monëdes ves cuntará n valgügn mituns la storia.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: La isola de Bowen é na escurjiun popolara de n de o de na fin dla edema che pita la poscibilité da fá kayak, jí sö por munt, rodé fora por botëghes, restoranc y ciamó n gröm de ater patüc lapró.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Chësta comunité autentica é a Howe Sound atira fora de Vancouver y an ti pó pormez saurí cun taxi sön ega che pëia ia da Granville Island tla cité interna de Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Por chi che á ion ativités alaleria é na escurjiun sön le percurs Sea to Sky essenziala.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1.5 ores de auto dalunc da Vancouver) é cera mo dër conesciüda porvia di Jüc Olimpics da d'Invern dl 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: D'invern pón se gode n valgönes dles plü beles pistes da jí cun i schi dla America dl Nord y d'isté pón porvé fora n valgügn trus por la roda da munt autentics.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Les autorisaziuns mëss gní resservades danfora. I messëis avëi na autorisaziun da sté sura nöt tl Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena é la sora staziun di rangers che pita n post da sté suranöt y pasć cialc pro le camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo y Los Patos pita ma la poscibilité da fá camping zënza sorvisc da mangé.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Al pó gní damané les autorisaziuns da parché diretamënter tla staziun di rangers a Puerto Jiménez, mo ai ne azetëia nia chertes de credit.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Le sorvisc da parché (MINAE) ne scrí nia fora la autorisaziun da parché plü co n mëis denant che an röies adalerch.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol pita n sorvisc de resservaziun por n cost de US$30, o $10 por le pas de n de; detais sön süa plata Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Les Cook Islands é n paisc insular lié lediamënter cun la Zelanda Nöia, tla Polinesia, amesa l'Ozean Pazifich Meridional.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Al é n arzipel cun 15 isoles sparpagnades fora sura 2,2 miliuns de km2 tl ozean.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Cun la medema zona temporala sciöche Hawaii vëgn les isoles datrai definides sciöche "Hawaii Down Under".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Ince sce ara é plü picera ti recordera a n valgügn vijitadus plü vedli sciöche Hawaii ciarâ fora denant zënza düc chi gragn hotei y le rest dl svilup.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Les isoles Cook ne á nia cités mo ares é formades da 15 isoles desvalies. Les plü granes é Rarotonga y Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Ti paisc svilupá d'aldedaincö é la oferta de ciamenes cun gosté de lus gnüda na sort de forma de ert.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Söinsom concorëiel pro i B&B sambëgn döes cosses prinzipales: la blanciaria da let y le gosté.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: De conseguënza spera un da ciafé tles strotöres plü fines le let plü de lus, poester na cutra fata a man o n let antich.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Da gosté pón ciafé particolarités de sajun dla regiun o spezialités dl patrun de ciasa.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Sciöche cornisc pón avëi na ciasa storica vedla cun n aredamënt antich, n terac arjigné ca dër bel y na nodadoia.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Senté te osc auto y pié ia por n iade lunch á na atraziun döta süa te süa scemplité.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: A desfarënzia da de maius auti savarëise bonamënter bele da avisé osc auto y i conesciarëis sües limitaziuns.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Mëte sö na tënda sön na proprieté privata o te na cité belanfat de ci grandëza pó atrá saurí atenziuns nia orüdes.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: En cört é l'adoranza de osc auto n bun tru da fá n bel iade sön strada, mo dainré na opziun da "se aciampé".
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: I podëis ves aciampé cun l'auto sce i ëis n gran minivan, n SUV, na berlina o n station wagon cun sic che an pó lascé dofora.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: N valgügn hotí á na arpejun dala eté de or dles ferates a tanf o di transatlantics, dan la Secunda Vera dl Monn, tl XIX y XX secul.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Chisc hotí ê le post olache la jënt rica y conesciüda stô ia por le de y olache an ciafâ gonot ince valch de bun da mangé y na vita de nöt.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Le stil vedl, la mancianza dles ultimes comodités y na certa grazia zënza tëmp fej ince pert de so carater.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Scebëgn che ai sides de proprieté privata ti dái alberch datrai a capi de Stat o de atres personalités en vijita.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: N viagiadú cun n gröm de scioldi podess tó en conscidraziun na roda dl monn cun le fligher, despartida da sojornanzes te n gröm de chisc hotí.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Na rëi de barat de ospitalité é na organisaziun che conliëia viagiadus cun la jënt dl post tles cités che ai vá a vijité.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Da rové te na te rëi mësson normalmënter ma scrí fora n formular online, ince sce n valgönes rëis pita o damana ince n control injunté.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Na lista de cuartiers a desposiziun vëgn spo metüda a desposiziun te na forma stampada y/o online, datrai cun referënzes y rezenjiuns de de atri viagiadus.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing ê gnü fondé de jená dl 2004 do che le programadú informatich Casey Fenton â ciafé n jore bunmarcé tla Islanda mo ne â nia plü ciafé lerch da sté suranöt.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Al ti â scrit na e-mail a studënc dla université locala y â ciafé n gröm de ofertes por abitaziuns debann.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: I alberc dla jonëza tol sö dantadöt jënt jona - n sciore tipich á plü o manco vint agn - mo an ciafa gonot ince viagiadus plü vedli iló.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Families cun mituns vëigon dainré, mo cer alberc dla jonëza ti conzed da sté te ciamenes privates.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: La cité de Beijing tla Cina sará la cité che ti dará alberch ai Jüc Olimpics da d'invern dl 2022, che la trasformará tla pröma cité che ará ospité sides i Jüc Olimpics da d'isté co da d'invern.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing metará man sciöche ospitant les zerimonies de daurida y de stlüta y les manifestaziuns sön dlacia daite.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Al gnará tigní de atres manifestaziuns cun i schi tl raiun da jí cun i schi de Taizicheng tl Zhangjiakou, incër 220 km (140 milies) dalunc da Beijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: La maiú pert di tëmpli tëgn n festival anual che mët man de novëmber y se röia a mez ma, che müda aladô dl calënder anual de vigni tëmpl.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: La maiú pert dles festes dl tëmpl vëgn zelebrades sciöche pert dl aniversar dl tëmpl o sciöche compliann dla divinité plü alta o vigni ater evënt plü important lié cun le tëmpl.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Les festes tl tëmpl de Kerala é dër interessantes da odëi, cun prozesciuns regolares di elefanc decorá, la musiga dl tëmpl y de atri festejamënc.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Na fiera mondiala (a chëra che an ti dij normalmënter Esposiziun Mondiala, o bel scëmpl Expo) é na gran festa internazionala dla ert y dla sciënza.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: I paisc partezipanc presënta sü esponac artistics y educazionai te paiuns nazionai por mostré sö argomënc globai o la cultura y la storia de so paisc.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.
