text: Les esposiziuns internazionales de orticultura é spezialisades sön manifestaziuns che mostra les composiziuns floreales, i urc botanics y döt ci che á da nen fá cun les plantes.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Scemia ch'ares podess en teoria gní metüdes a jí vigni ann (tan inant ch'ares é te Paisc desvalis), n'éra tla pratica nia insciö.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Chisc evënc döra de regola da trëi a sis mëisc y vëgn tignis te sic che n'é nia mëndri co 50 hectars.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Al é tröc formac desvalis de film che é gnüs adorá ti agn. Le film standard da 35 mm (negatifs de 36 por 24 mm) é le plü adoré.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: De regola pól saurí gní mudé fora sc'al se röia y pita na ressoluziun ch'an pó plü o manco paridlé cun n DSLR da sëgn.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Val' aparac da fá fotos de format mesan adora n format de 6 por 6 cm, plü avisa n negatif de 56 por 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Chësc pita na ressoluziun che é feter cater iadi tan grana co chëra de n negatif da 35 mm (3136 mm² cuntra 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: I tiers salvari é danter i motifs plü impegnatifs por n fotograf y á debojëgn de na combinaziun de fortüna, paziënza, esperiënza y n bun echipamënt.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: La fotografia di tiers salvari vëgn gonot tuta por val' de normal, mo coch'ara é pro la fotografia en general, vel n retrat tan co mile parores.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: La fotografia de tiers salvari se ghira sovënz n teleobietif lunch, ince sce cosses coche na schira de vicí o na picia creatöra á debojëgn de d'atri obietifs.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Tröc tiers esotics é ri da ciafé y i parcs á val' iade regoles en cunt dl fá fotografies por fins comerziai.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Tiers salvari pó ester o spaui o agressifs. L'ambiënt incëria pó ester frëit, cialt o zënza a val' manira ostil.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Le monn á deplü co 5.000 lingac desvalis, olache deplü co 20 á passa 50 miliuns o deplü porsones che le baia.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Parores scrites é sovënz ince plü saurides da capí co parores baiades. Chësc vel dantadöt por chës cosses che é ries da pronunzié te na manira tlera.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Tröpes naziuns intieres baia inglesc zënza dificoltés y ciamó te deplü Paisc pón s'aspeté n cer savëi - dantadöt danter i plü jogn.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Imaginëiete, sce t'os, n mancunian, n bostonian, n giamaican y n sydneian sentá incër na mësa a cëna te n restorant a Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Ai s'la ciacola un cun l'ater cun stories de sües cités nadé, cuntades cun sü azënc destintifs y jargons locai.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Cumpré mangiaria ti supermarciá é de regola la manira plü bun marcé da se nudrí. Sc'an n'á nia la poscibilité da cujiné, é la lita te vigni caje limitada al patüc da mangé bele arjigné danfora.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Tres deplü ciafa i supermarciá na seziun plü rica de varieté de mangiaria bele arjignada. N valgügn á ince n furnel a micro-ones o d'atri mesi da scialdé le mangé.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Te val' Paisc o sorts de botëghes él almanco un n restorant söl post, sovënz plütosc informal y cun prisc convegnënc.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Fá y tolete para copies de tüa poliza y le contat de to assiguradú.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: An mëss mostré sö la misciun e-mail dl assiguradú y i numeri de telefon internazionai por consulënzes/autorisaziuns y damané retüdes.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Tëgn sö ciamó na copia te to cufer y online (menada por e-mail a te instës cun l'injunta, o memorisada tla "cloud").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Sc'an viagëia cun n laptop o tablet, mëte ia na copia sö süa memoria o disch (da podëi rové pormez zënza l'internet).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Dédi ince copies dla poliza/di contac ai compagns de iade y a parënc o amisc a ciasa, che é a öna da daidé.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: I alc (ince conesciüs coche alc) n'é pordërt nia agressifs, mo ai se defënn sc'ai sënt da ester tl prigo.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Canche porsones mina che i alc n'é nia prigorusc, pól ester ch'ares ti vais massa pormez y se mëtes instësses tl prigo.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Bër les boandes alcoliches cun mosöra. L'alcol á sön vignun n'atra faziun y conësce so limit é dër important.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Danter les cosses che pó sozede tl tëmp lunch dal bëre demassa pól ester dagns al fié y ince la vercité y la mort. Le prigo potenzial devënta ciamó majer sc'al vëgn consumé alcol prodüt te na manira ilegala.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Boandes alcoliches ilegales pó contigní deplü sorts de impurités prigoroses, lapró le metanol, che pó gaujé la vercité y la mort ince ma cun de pices cuantités.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: I odlá pó ester miú marcé te d'atri Paisc, dantadöt te Paisc cun n livel de davagn bas olache i cosć por le laur é plü basc.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Tolede en conscidraziun l'idea da fá na vijita ai edli a ciasa, cis sce l'assiguraziun la paia, y da ves tó para la prescriziun por la dé jö invalgó d'ater.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Pontins di odlá de na marca de livel alt ch'an ciafa te de te posć pó avëi dui problems; na pert pó ester fac do y chi che vëgn veramënter importá pó costé ciamó deplü co a ciasa.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Le café é un di produc plü comerzialisá al monn y bonamënter poste nen ciafé de tröpes sorts tla regiun olache t'es da ciasa.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Porimpó él tröpes manires desvalies da bëre café sura döt le monn, ch'al paia la möia da porvé fora.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Le canyoning (o: canyoneering) é le jí jö do le funz de n frignun, che n'é ne süt ne plëgn d'ega.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Le canyoning mët adöm elemënc dl nodé, dl arpizé y trá salc – mo se ghira plütosc püch alenamënt o forma fisica por podëi mëte man da le fá (en confrunt al arpizé sö por crëp, jí sot ega o schi alpin, por ejëmpl).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Le jí a pe é n'ativité da defora pro chëra ch'an vá a pe te ambiënc naturai, sovënz do sëmenes da jí a pe.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Les escurjiuns de n de vá da destanzes de manco co na milia cina a destanzes plü lunges che pó gní fates te un n de su.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Por na escurjiun de n de do n tru saurí ól ma ester püch alenamënt y vigni porsona che é n pü' en forma pó s'la gode.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Families cun de pici mituns podess avëi debojëgn da s'arjigné ca deplü, mo n de alaleria vá saurí da fá ince cun viadus y mituns che ne vá nia ciamó a scora.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: A livel internazional él incër 200 organisaziuns che mët a jí tours da salté. La maiú pert de chëstes laora te na manira independënta.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Le suzessur de Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours coliëia te na rëi desënes de fornidus de sightrunning te cater continënc.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Da avëi raisc tl Running Tours de Barcelona y tl Running Copenhagen de Copenhagen, él tosc gnü pormez le Running Tours Prague cun sënta a Praga y d'atri.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Al é tröpes cosses ch'an mëss tigní en conscidraziun denant y canch'an viagëia invalgó.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Canche te viagëies, tëgn cunt che les cosses n'é nia coche ares é "a ciasa". Les usanzes, les leges, le mangé, la mobilité, le dormí, i standarg, le lingaz y insciö inant sará n pü' atramënter co olache te vires.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Chësc é valch che te mësses tres dé amënt, por evité delujiuns o poester ince n'averjiun por les manires da fá dl post.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Agenzies de iade él dal 19ejim secul incá. N'agenzia de iade é de regola na bona opziun por n iade che vá sura les esperiënzes bele fates fora, de natöra, cultura, lingaz o Paisc cun n livel de davagn bas.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Ince sce la maiú pert é a öna da tó sö la maiú pert dles prenotaziuns normales, se spezialisëia tröc rapresentanc sön manires particolares da viagé, fasces de budget o destinaziuns.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Ara pó jí damí da tó n rapresentant che prenotëia gonot de te iadi coche le to.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Ciari ai iadi che le rapresentant é tl laur da promöie, sides öna na plata web o te na vidrina de botëga.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Sce t'os odëi le monn zënza spëne demassa, por tü bojëgns, stil de vita o por sfida, spo esistel deplü manires por le fá.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: De basa tomeres ite te döes categories: lauré tratan che an é söl iade o ciaré da limité les spëises. Chësc articul se conzentrëia söla secunda.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Por chi che é a öna da sacrifiché comodité, tëmp y planificaziun por smendrí les spëises cina jö a zero, él da ti ciaré ai iadi cun n budget minim.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Le consëi se basëia söla premissa che chi viagëia ne arobes nia, respetëies la proprieté privata, ne fejes nia para pro ativités ilegales, ne pëtles nia o sfrutëies nia d'atres porsones por sü interesc.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: N punt de control dl'imigraziun é de regola le pröm stop canche an vëgn jö da n fligher, da na barca o da n ater meso de trasport.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Sön valgönes ferates che vá sura i confins fora vëgnel fat controi tratan le iade, porchël fossel bun da avëi dagnora n documënt d'identité varënt canche an vá söles ferates de chësta sort.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Söles ferates de nöt él le ciafer che pó cöie adöm i passaporc por ne ves descedé nia tl sonn.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: La registraziun é n recuisit implü por l'emisciun dl visum. Te n valgügn paisc él debojëgn da registré tüa presënza y misciun de residënza pro les autorités dl post.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Al pó ester che chësc se damanes da scrí fora n formular pro la polizia dl post o da jí ti ofizi imigraziun.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Te tröc paisc cun na lege de chësta sort sarál i hotí dl post che manajará la registraziun (damanede do por na sigüda).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Te d'atri caji vëgnel damané la registraziun ma a chi che ne stá nia te strotöres turistiches. Insciö é indere la lege manco tlera, porchël ciarede da ves informé denant.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: L'architetöra á da nen fá cun la planificaziun y le frabiché de ciases. L'architetöra de n post é gonot n'atraziun turistica deplëgn.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Tröc frabicac é bindebó bi da ti ciaré y le panorama da na ciasa alta o da na finestra te na bona posiziun pó ester na belëza da amiré.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: L'architetöra vá insuralater cun d'atri ciamps te na manira significativa, coche l'urbanistica, l'injiniaria zivila, les erts decoratives, le design por interns y l'architetöra dla contrada.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Sc'an conscidrëia tan dalunc che i pueblos é, spo ne podaraste nia ciafé na gran vita de nöt zënza jí cina Albuquerque o Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Porimpó él prësc düc i casinó dá dant che pita da bëre y n valgügn pita ince devertimënc de lus (dantadöt chi maius dlungia Albuquerque y Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Metede averda: i bars dles pices cités n'é nia dagnora posć adatá por vijitadus da foradecá.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Dantadöt á le New Mexico n gran problem cun chi che vá cun l'auto da cioc y la conzentraziun de autisć cioc é alta dlungia i bars dles pices cités.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Depënc sön mür o scrizernades nia orüdes é conesciüs coche grafic.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Scemia che al n'é daldöt nia n fenomen modern, él bonamënter tröc che l'assoziëia ai jogn che danejëia la proprieté publica y privata cun corusc a spray.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Porimpó él aldedaincö artisć de grafic reconesciüs, manifestaziuns liá ai grafic y mürs "legai". Te chësc contest ti somëia les pitöres-grafic deplü a de dërtes operes d'ert co a simboi che ne vá nia da lí.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Trá le boomerang é n'abilité popolara che tröc turisć ó imparé.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Sce t'os imparé da trá n boomerang che vëgn zoruch te tües mans, spo ciara che t'ais n boomerang adaté por chësc.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: La maiú pert di boomerang te Australia ne vëgn de fat nia zoruch. Por i prinzipianc él damí da ne porvé nia da trá canche al é da vënt.
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Le past tradizional Hangi vëgn cujiné te na büja cialda ciavada ite tl grunt.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: La büja vëgn scialdada cun peres de n füch o te val' post él le cialt geotermich che scialda i raiuns de terac naturalmënter.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Le hangi vëgn gonot adoré da cujiné na cëna te n stil apraté tradizional.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: De plü posć a Rotorua pita le hangi geotermal, deperpo che de atri hangi pó gní ciarciá a Christchurch, Wellington y invalgó d'ater.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail á döes classes sön les ferates pendolares te y incër Cape Town: MetroPlus (a chëra che al ti vëgn ince dit Pröma Classa) y Metro (a chëra che al ti vëgn ince dit Terza Classa).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus é plü da sté saurí y manco afolé mo ince plü cer, ince sce al é tres ciamó plü bunmarcé co na cherta normala dla metro t'Europa.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Vigni ferata á vaguns sides MetroPlus co Metro; i vaguns MetroPlus é dagnora ala fin dla ferata, che é plü dlungia Cape Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Trasporté por de atri - mai lascé üsc cufri fora de osta odlada, dantadöt nia canche i passëis confins internazionai.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: An podess gní adorá sciöche trasportadus de droga zënza che an s'intënes, ci che se menass te de gragn problems.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Chësc tol ite aspeté tla coda, dal momënt che al podess gní adoré cians che tofa la droga te vigni momënt y zënza preavis.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: N valgügn paisc á puniziuns dër stersces ince por ofenüdes che sozed le pröm iade, chëstes pó stlüje ite sentënzes da jí te porjun sura 10 agn o la mort.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Cufri nia custodis é n travert por chi che aroba y pó ince trá la atenziun dles autorités, che se tëm da manaces de bombes.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: A ciasa, sotmetüs a chësta esposiziun costanta de germs locai, él na gran probabilité che i sëis bele imuns a chisc.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Mo te de atres perts dl monn, olache la fauna bateriologica é nöia por os, é la probabilité cotan plü grana che i rovëis te problems.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Implü crësc i baters te climesc plü cialc plü debota y suravir plü dî fora dl corp.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Insciö i flagí de Delhi Belly, la maledisciun dl faraun, la revendicaziun de Montezuma y sü tröc compagns.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Sciöche problems de respiraziun te raiuns climatics plü frëic insciö vëgnel dant te raiuns climatics plü cialc plü gonot problems ai baroc y te n gröm de caji ési cotan da stufé mo nia propi prigorusc.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Sce i viagëis por le pröm iade te n paisc tl laur da se svilupé - o te na pert nöia dl monn - ne sotvalutede nia la spordüda dla cultura potenziala.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Tröc viagiadus stabii y bogn se á imprescioné dala novité di iadi mondiai te paisc che se svilupëia, olache n gröm de de pici aiustamënc culturai pó gní injuntá debota.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Dantadöt te üsc pröms dis conscidrede la idea da sojorné te hotí, mangé y sorvisc cun stil y cualité ozidentai, por se aclimatisé.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Ne dormide nia sön n madroz o n tapet ia por tera te raiuns olache i ne conescëis nia la fauna dl post.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Sce i jëis a ves aciampé tolesse para n let da ciamp o n linzó da naina por ves tigní dalunc da bisches, scorpiuns o de te tiers.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Implide fora osta ciasa cun n café rich dadoman y n tê da ampömes relassënt dassëra.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Canche i fajëis vacanza a ciasa ëise dlaurela da ves traté bun y ves tó n valgügn menüc extra da fá valch de particolar.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Sce i ves sintis plü aventurusc tolede la oportunité da fracé fora o da moscedé adöm val' sort de smoothies:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Al pó ester che i descuris na boanda scëmpla che i podëis fá da gosté, canche i jëis derevers te osta rutina da vigni de.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Sce i viëis te na cité cun na cultura dl bëre desvalia, jide te bars o pubs te cuartiers che i ne frecuentëis nia.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Por chi che ne á nia familiarité cun le jargon dla medejina á les parores infetif y contagius significac desvalis.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Na maratia infetiva é öna che vëgn gaujada da n patogen, sciöche n virus, n bater, n fongun o de atri parassic.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Na maratia contagiosa é na maratia che vëgn trasmetüda saurí da sté dlungia na porsona infetada.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: N gröm de governs ti damana ai vijitadus che röia adalerch, o ai residënc che s'un vá dal paisc che ai se fejes la variora cuntra na seria de maraties.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Chisc recuisic pó gonot depëne dai paisc che n viagiadú á vijité o ó vijité.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Un di punc stersc de Charlotte, tla Carolina dl Nord, é che ara á na abondanza de opziuns de cualité alta por les families.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Residënc de de atri raiuns dá gonot dant les beles manires ti confrunc dles families sciöche pröma rajun por jí a vire iló y i vijitadus arata gonot che la cité sides bela da odëi cun mituns.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Ti ultims vint agn é le numer de opziuns a bëgn di mituns a Uptown Charlotte chersciü esponenzialmënter.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: I taxi ne vëgn nia scialdi adorá dales families a Charlotte, ince sce ai pó ester ütli te certes zircostanzes.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Por plü co dui passajiers vëgnel damané n suplemënt insciö podess chësta opziun ester plü cera co ci che al ne vá debojëgn.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: L'Antartida é le post plü frëit dla Tera y é incër le Pol Süd ia.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Les vijites turistiches é ceres, ares se damana fitness fisich, pó ma gní fates d'isté (novëmber-forá) y é scialdi ma limitades ala penisola, ales isoles y al Mer de Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: N per de milesc de mëmbri dl personal vir chiló d'isté te n cater desënes de cuartiers scialdi te chisc raiuns; n pice numer é ince sura l'invern chiló.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: L'intern dla Antartida é n plateau sorënt curí da 2-3 km de dlacia.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Rodes cun fligri spezialisades y ocajionales mëna itepert, por jí sö por munt o por arjunje le Pol, che á na gran basa.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: La traversada dl Pol Süd (o autostrada) é na strada de 1.600 km dala staziun de McMurdo sön le Mer de Ross cina le Pol.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Ara se trata de nëi compata cun sfësses implides fora y amarsciades da bandires. An pó ma jí lassura cun tractors spezialisá che tira liöses cun ciarburant y proviant.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Chisc ne é nia dër asvelc, insciö che la strada mëss fá na gran ota incër i Crëps Transantartics ia por rové sön le plateau.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: La gauja plü conesciüda por i inzidënc d'invern é sbriscé sön les strades, trus da jí a pe (marciapisc) y dantadöt scalins.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Sciöche minim adorëise cialzá cun na sora adatada. Cialzá da d'isté é gonot plü lizi sön la dlacia o sön la nëi, datrai é cinamai stivá da d'invern massa püch.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Le profil messess ester sot assá, 5 mm (1/5 poresc) o deplü y le material morjel assá por temperatöres frëides.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: N valgügn stivá á ciodi y al esist ince injuntes cun ciodi canche al é dër lize, datá por la maiú pert di cialzá y di stivá, por le tach o por por le tach y la sora.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: I tac dess ester basc y lerc. Saurun, giara o se (clorid de calzium) vëgn gonot sciuré sön les strades o sön i trus por mioré la aderënza sön strada.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Lovines ne é nia valch fora dl normal; les pares ërtes pó ma tigní sö intan de nëi y les cuantités surafora vëgn jö sciöche lovines.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Le problem é che la nëi é tacosa, porchël ól ester valch da la destaché por che ara vëgnes jö y val' sort de nëi che vëgn jö pó ester la gauja che fej gní jö le rest.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Datrai é l'evënt che fej pié ia la nëi sorëdl che la scialda, datrai val' novüda implü, datrai de atri evënc naturai, gonot na porsona.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: N tornado é na corona de aria da na presciun dër bassa che drüca, che ciücia ite l'aria incëria y la lascia jí sö.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Ai generëia vënc alc (gonot cina 100-200 milies/ora) y pó alzé sö ogec pesoc tla aria, i trasportan sciöche le tornado se möi.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Ai mët man sciöche cus che vëgn jö da niores di temporai y se trasformëia te "tornados" canche ai azica le terac.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: I fornidus personai VPN (virtual private network) é n tru ezelënt da ti sciampé sides ala zensöra politica co al filter geografich comerzial IP.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Ai é mius co i web proxies por de plü rajuns: ai oj danü döt le trafich internet, nia ma le http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Ai pita normalmënter na larghëza dla banda de frecuënza plü alta y na miú cualité di sorvisc. Ai é criptá y chësc porta pro che al é plü ri da i spié.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Les compagnies mediatiches mënt regolarmënter por ci che reverda chësta intenziun, dijon che al é por "prevegní la pirataria".
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: De fat ne á i codesc regionai assolutamënter degun efet sön la copia ilegala; na copia bit sön bit de na scëiba vá jö zënza problems olache l'original vá ince.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: La intenziun atuala é chëra da ti dé ales compagnies n maiú control sön sü marciá; ara nen vá dagnora da lascé rodé i scioldi.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Porvia che les telefonades vëgn dejotes sön internet ne adorëise nia plü na compagnia telefonica metüda olache i abitëis o olache i viagëis.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Al ne vëgn gnanca damané che i ëis n numer local dla comunité olache i viëis; i podëis ciafé na conesciun internet satelitara tla pert salvaria de Chicken, tla Alaska y chirí fora n numer che i orëis cherdé sö tla Arizona soredlada.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Gonot messëise cumpré n numer global despartí che conzedes telefonades PSTN por ves cherdé sö. Le numer olache i sëis fej fora la desfarënzia por les porsones che ves chërda sö.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Aplicaziuns de traduturs de tesć te n tëmp real - aplicaziuns che é bones da traslaté automaticamënter segmënc intiers de n test da n lingaz al ater.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: N valgönes dles aplicaziuns te chësta categoria pó ince traslaté tesć te lingac foresć sön tofles o de atri ogec tl monn real, sce l'anuzadú drüca le smartphone tla direziun de chisc ogec.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: I motors de traduziun se á mioré dramaticamënter y dá sëgn gonot traduziuns plü o manco coretes (y dainré frases nia da capí), mo al é impó da mëte averda, ciodiche ai podess tres ciamó capí döt damat.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Öna dles app plü conesciüdes te chësta categoria é Google Translate, che conzed da fá traduziuns offline, do che an se á desćiarié i dac dl lingaz dejidré.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: La adoranza de apps de navigaziun GPS sön osc smartphone pó ester le tru plü saurí y plü convegnënt da navighé canche i sëis dalunc da osc paisc.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: An pó sparagné scioldi da cumpré chertes nöies por n GPS, o n aparat de navigaziun GPS autonom o s'un impresté fora un da na compagnia che imprësta fora auti.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Sce i ne ëis degöna conesciun ai dac por osc fonin o sce al ne pëia nia pó so funzionamënt ester limité o nia a desposiziun.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Vigni botëga te ciantun é implida cun na seria sotissura de chertes dl fonin prepaiades che pó gní adorades da telefons a paiamënt o da telefons normai.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Scebëgn che la maiú pert dles chertes vais bun da telefoné indlunch, nen él n valgönes che é spezialisades por telefonades plü bunmarcé te grups spezifics de paisc.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: L'azes a chisc sorvisc sozed gonot tres n numer de telefon lëde da cutes che pó gní cherdé sö dala maiú pert di fonins debann.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Les regoles che reverda la fotografia regolara vëgn ince aplicades por la registraziun video y poester ince ciamó deplü.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Sc'an ne pó cinamai gnanca fá jö val', ne mësson gnanca tó en conscidraziun da tó sö n video.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Sc'an adora n drone, controlëia cotan danfora ci che te pos tó sö y ci autorisaziuns o lizënzes implü che vá debojëgn.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Jí cun le drone dlungia n aeroport o sura na fola de jënt fora é feter dagnora na stleta idea, ince sc'al n’é nia ilegal te osta zona.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Aldedaincö él ri che i iadi coi fligri vëgnes prenotá diretamënter dala compagnia de fligher zënza avëi impröma chirí y confronté i prisc.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Datrai pó le medemo jore avëi prisc dër desvalis danter i operadus y porchël convëgnel confronté i resultac dl’archirida y consulté la plata internet dla compagnia de fligher denanco prenoté.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Scemia che te ne adores nia n visum por sojornanzes cörtes te val’ paisc sciöche turist o por motifs de laur, adoreste indere por jí te n paisc sciöche studënt internazional na sojornanza plü lungia co chëra de n turist ocajional scëmpl.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: De regola vál debojëgn da ciafé n visum danfora por sté te n stat ester por plü dî.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: I visums por studënc á en general recuisic y prozedöres de domanda desfarëntes co i visums por turism o afars.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Por la maiú pert di paisc adoreste na lëtra de pita da pert dl istitut olach'an ó studié, mo ince i mesi finanziars che vá debojëgn por sostigní almanco le pröm ann de curs.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Damana do al istitut y al ofize dl imigraziun dl paisc olache te os jí a studié por ciafé informaziuns avisa sön i recuisic.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: A condiziun che te ne sides nia n diplomatich, lauré foradecá comporta de regola le paiamënt dla cuta söl davagn tl paisc olache te te ciafes.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: La cuta söl davagn é strotorada te na manira desfarënta ti paisc y les alicuotes y les classes tributares se müda dassënn da n paisc al ater.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Te n valgügn paisc federai, sciöche i Stac Unis y le Canada, vëgn la cuta söl davagn scudida sides a livel federal co a livel local, porchël pó les alicuotes y les categories fiscales mudé da raiun a n ater.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Deperpo che le control dl'imigraziun é da degöna importanza o scialdi ma na formalité canch'an röia indô tl paisc nadé, pó indere le control doganal jí söles stlares.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Assigurëiete da savëi ci che te pos o ne pos nia tó para y detlaré döt ci che vá sura i limic de lege fora.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: La manira plü scëmpla da mëte man da scrí libri de iade é chëra da lauré fora tües capazités sön na plata internet de relaziuns de iade renomada.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Do avëi imparé da formaté y edité tl web, podaraste plü inant cherié tüa plata internet.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Fá volontariat tratan le iade é na bela manira da dé n contribut, mo ara ne se trata nia ma da dé.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Vire y fá volontariat te n paisc forest é na gran manira por imparé da conësce n'atra cultura, incunté porsones nöies, imparé da se conësce instësc, ciafé na prospetiva nöia y cinamai rové pro competënzes nöies.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Al pó ince ester na bona manira por aumenté le bilanz y sté plü dî inzai d'ater, deache tröc laurs de volontariat pita spëisa y alberch y n valgügn paia por le laur fat.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: I Vichings adorâ les strades söl'ega rusces por arjunje le Mer Fosch y le Mer Caspich. N valgönes perts de chëstes rutes pó ciamó gní adorades. Verifichëia le bojëgn eventual de autorisaziuns speziales, che podess ester ries da arjunje.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Le Canal Blanch-Baltich coliëia le Mer Dlacial Artich cun le Mer Baltich, passan por le Lech Onega, le Lech Ladoga y San Petersburg, por le plü fora por rüs y lec.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Le Lech Onega é ince colié cun Volga, porchël vára ciamó da gní dal Mer Caspich fora por la Ruscia.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Pornanche i arëis arjunt i porc de mer turistics sarál döt bindebó saurí. I incuntarëis d'atri che fej autostop y ai partiará cun os sües informaziuns.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: En sostanza messaraste taché sö avisc por pité osc aiüt, lauré sön i cantiers, ti baié ados ales porsones che puzenëia sües barches, porvé da tó sö contat cun i marinas dl bar, y.i.i.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Porvede da baié cun plü porsones che ara vá. Do da n pez ves conesciará düc y ai ves dará consëis sön ci barca che é tla laur da chirí zacai.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: An dess chirí fora avisa süa compagnia di fligri danter n'alianza de jori frecuënc.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Scebëgn che an pó ponsé ch’al sides intuitif da tó na compagnia cun chëra che an jora le plü, desson savëi che i vantaji pitá é gonot desvalis y an pó ciafé deplü punc pro na compagnia de fligri dla medema coaliziun.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Les compagnies de fligri sciöche Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways y Turkish Airlines á aumenté dassënn sü sorvisc tl'Africa, y pita coliamënc cun tröpes de gran cités africanes a n prisc che ti fej concorënza a d'atres compagnies europeiches.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: La Turkish Airlines á 39 destinaziuns te 30 paisc africans dal 2014 inant.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Sce an á deplü tëmp da viagé pón confronté la tarifa indöt por l'Africa cun chëra de n iade incër le monn.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: No te desmentié i cosć implü por d'atri visa, por les cutes de dejore, i trasporc a tera y.i.i te düc i paisc fora dl'Africa.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Sce i orëis rodé incër döt le monn ia tl'emisfera dl süd, é la cerna di jori y dles destinaziuns limitada deache al n'é nia tröpes trasses da un n ozean al ater.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Degönes alianzes de compagnies de fligri ne cür les traversades ozeaniches tl'emisfera dl süd (y SkyTeam ne cür degöna dles traversades).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Mo Star Alliance cür feter döta la zona, a pert le Pazifich dl Süd oriental da Santiago de Chile a Tahiti, che vëgn curí da LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Chësc jore n'é nia la sora opziun sce an ó lascé fora le Pazifich dl Süd y la spona ozidentala dl'America dl Süd. (ciara dessot)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Tl 994, ti á la regiun etnica armena Nagorno-Karabakh dl Azerbaijan detlará vera ai azeris.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Cun l'aiüt di armens él gnü cherié na republica nöia. Indere ne l'á degöna naziun consolidada - gnanca l'Armenia - reconesciüda ofizialmënter.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Les discusciuns diplomatiches sön la regiun sciüra tres ciamó sotissura les relaziuns danter l'Armenia y l'Azerbaijan.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Le raiun di canai (por olandesc: Grachtengordel) é le conesciü raiun dl 17ejim secul incër la Binnenstad de Amsterdam ia.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Döt le raiun é gnü detlaré pert dl Patrimone mondial UNESCO por so valur cultural y storich unich, y le valur de sü imobii. é danter i maius dl paisc.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Les Cinque Terre, chël ó dí les cin teres, tol ite i cin pici paisc de spona de Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza y Monterosso tla regiun taliana Liguria.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Ares é tla lista dl Patrimone mondial UNESCO.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Ti secui á la jënt fat sö cun cura terasses tla contrada ërta y groia, bel cina söinsom dles scolieres che pica sö sura le mer.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Süa fascinaziun vëgn en pert dal fat che al n'é nia da odëi frabicac de aziëndes. Trus, ferates y barches coliëia i paisc, y i auti ne röia nia pormez.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Les variantes dl franzesc che vëgn baiades tl Belgio y tla Svizera se desfarenziëia n püch dal franzesc tla Francia, mo ares se somëia impó tan da gní capides da trames les perts.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: En particolar á le sistem da cumpedé tl Belgio y tla Svizera francofona n valgönes de pices particolarités che é atramënter co tl franzesc baié tla Francia, y la pronunzia de n valgönes parores é n pü' atramënter.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Porimpó impara düc i belgs y svizeri le franzesc standard te scora, insciö pói ves capí ince sce i adorëis le sistem da cumpedé dl franzesc standard.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Te tröpes perts dl monn é le saludé cun la man n gest de cherianza por dí "oila".
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Mo tla Malaisia, altamo danter i abitanc ti raiuns rurai dla Malaisia, ól dí "ví ca", coche canche an storj le dëit da mostré devers dl corp, n gest che vëgn adoré te certi paisc dl vest y dess gní adoré ma por chël fin.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Tla medema manira, podess n viagiadú britanich tla Spagna capí mal le gest da möie la man por tó comié cun la palpa dla man ota devers dla porsona che salüda (y nia devers dla porsona che an salüda) y le tó sö coche n gest da fá gní derevers.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: I lingac ausiliars é lingac artifiziai o costruis, cheriá cun le fin da sauridé la comunicaziun danter porsones che se stentass zënza da comuniché.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Ai se desfarenziëia dai lingac francs, che é lingac naturai o organics che por val' rajun devënta dominanc danter porsones che baia d'atri lingac.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Dal gran cialt ia por le de pó i viagiadus vire cosses imaginares che ti dá l'ilujiun da odëi ega (o d'ater).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Chëstes podess ester prigoroses sce le viagiadú ti vá do ala cossa imaginara, spaterlan ia energia preziosa y l'ega che avanza.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Ince le desert plü cialt pó deventé dër frëit de nöt. L'ipotermia é n dër risch zënza guanc cialc.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Dantadöt d'isté mësson mëte averda ai moscoruns sce an se tol dant da passé fora por n bosch tropical.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Ince sce i jëis cun l'auto fora por le bosch subtropical, bastel püc secunc cun les portes davertes deperpo ch’i se sentëis ite por che i moscoruns röies ite tl veicul cun os.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: La coia di vicí, o plü formalmënter l'aviaria, pó infeté sides i vicí co i mamifers.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Manco co mile caji é gnüs documentá pro les porsones, mo n valgügn de chisc ê fatai.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Por le plü êl porsones che laora cun polam, mo n cer risch él ince pro i osservadus de vicí.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Tipics por la Norvegia é i fiords ërc y les valades che fora de nia devënta n plan d'altöra plü o manco valí.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Chisc plans d'altöra vëgn gonot tlamá "vidde" minan n post ampl, davert y zënza lëgns, na estenjiun zënza confins.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: A Rogaland y a Agder vëgni de regola tlamá "hei" minan na contrada de parü zënza lëgns y gonot curida da lisöra.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: I dlaciá n'é nia stabii, mo sbriscia jö por le crëp. Chësc gaujëia sfësses, bujuns che pó gní stopá pro da punc de nëi.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: I parëis y le sössot di andri da dlacia pó tomé ite y les sfësses pó se stlüje pro.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Dai urs di dlaciá se destaca pedruns enorms che toma jö, y sprinza forsc o brodora dalunc dal ur.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: La sajun turistica ti posć söi coi arjunj de regola le punt plü alt tratan l'isté indian.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Mo ai á n'atra belëza y fascinaziun tratan l'invern, i tröc posć söi coi curis da tröpa nëi pita ativités coche le jí cun i schi o cun la brëia.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Ma püces compagnies de fligri pita ciamó tarifes te n caje de mort, cun na picia reduziun de prisc por n jore al ultimo menüt da jí a na sopoltöra.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Les compagnies de fligri che pita chësc é Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa por i jori dai Tac Unis o dal Canada demez, y WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Te vigni caje mësson prenoté cherdan diretamënter sö la compagnia de fligri.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
